blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)可以产生对复杂病例的差别诊断,但有用的第二种意见也必须基于事实、临床一致、可操作和安全。 我们利用300起诊断性解决的NEJM-MedQA病例制定了多层面基准:110起用于医生参考评级和法官校正,190起用于暂停评价。 8个单型管线在自由形式和结构化的临床合理条件下产生独立的角色特定意见和互动-consilium报告. 一名经医生校准的LLM法官评价了3 040份最后报告和相应的结构化初级作用产出。 模式身份分离报告的质量比反应格式更强。 结构化最后报告在8个示范管道中的7个管道的总体平均分数较高,在管理方面具有最明显的优势(2.740对2.436)。 与结构化的组合前主要作用意见相比,完整的结构化综合在所有5个共同标准中集合得分较高,问题优先排序、事实依据和推理一致性增加最多。 GPT-5.6-Sol领导了每一个被评价的部分,并在最少几轮审查中达成共识. 这些调查结果表明,基准可以区分模型能力、多学科综合的贡献、反应结构的具体标准影响、审议动态以及一个共同案例评价中的推断要求。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models have already demonstrated substantial progress on complex diagnostic tasks. GPT-4 generated clinically meaningful differential diagnoses for cases from the Case Records of the Massachusetts General Hospital , a long-running clinicopathological-conference series published in the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM) ( Brinkmann et al., 2024 ; Kanjee et al., 2023 ) . We refer to cases from this series as “NEJM cases.” Subsequent studies reported strong performance on challenging clinical cases across multiple specialties ( Rutledge, 2024 ; Hirosawa et al., 2024 ) . In the study by McDuff et al., the Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer (AMIE) system was evaluated on 302 NEJM cases and demonstrated strong performance both when independently generating differential diagnoses and when used by physicians as a decision-support tool ( McDuff et al., 2025 ) . These findings suggest that contemporary LLMs are already capable of making a meaningful contribution to diagnostic reasoning in complex clinical cases.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型在复杂的诊断任务方面已经显示出实质性的进展。 GPT-4从"马萨诸塞总医院案例记录"中产生了临床上有意义的差异诊断,该案例记录是"新英格兰医学杂志"(NEJM)上发表的长期临床病理学-会议系列(Brinkmann等,2024;Kanjee等,2023). 我们把这一系列案件称为“NEJM案件”。 随后的研究表明,在对多个专业的临床病例提出挑战方面表现良好(Rutledge, 2024;Hirosawa等, 2024)。 在McDuff等人的研究中,Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer(AMIE)系统对302个NEJM病例进行了评价,并在独立生成差分诊断和被医生用作决策支持工具时表现出了强效性能(McDuff等人,2025年). 这些调查结果表明,当代的有限责任公司已经能够对复杂临床病例的诊断推理作出有意义的贡献。

blocks.en: However, a clinical second opinion is not reducible to generating a differential diagnosis or selecting the most likely diagnostic hypothesis. A second opinion may change the representation of the patient’s condition, identify missing or contradictory information, reprioritize diagnostic hypotheses, alter the diagnostic workup or treatment strategy, and highlight previously underestimated risks. Studies by Payne et al. and Meyer et al. have shown that repeat expert review may lead to changes not only in diagnosis but also in treatment, with management changes in some settings occurring more frequently than diagnostic changes; moreover, it is not always possible to determine objectively which of the two opinions was more accurate ( Payne et al., 2014 ; Meyer et al., 2015 ) . Thus, for LLMs, high diagnostic accuracy alone does not imply a high-quality clinical second opinion: diagnostic agreement does not fully capture factual grounding, the coherence of reasoning, the quality of diagnostic and therapeutic planning, uncertainty, or clinical safety.
blocks.zh: 然而,临床第二意见不能被简化为产生差别诊断或选择最可能的诊断假说. 第二种意见可能改变病人的病情表现,识别缺失或相矛盾的信息,重新确定诊断假设的优先次序,改变诊断工作或治疗策略,并突出以前低估的风险。 Payne等人的研究。 14 和 Meyer等人的报告。 已经表明,重复的专家审查不仅可能导致诊断和治疗方面的改变,一些环境中的管理变化比诊断变化更频繁;此外,并不总是能够客观地确定两种意见中哪一种更准确(Payne等,2014年;Meyer等,2015年)。 因此,仅对LLMS而言,高诊断准确性并不意味着高质量的临床第二意见:诊断协议不能充分反映事实依据、推理的一致性、诊断和治疗规划的质量、不确定性或临床安全。

blocks.en: One approach to improving LLM performance is to explicitly structure the reasoning process. In radiology tasks, separating the structuring of clinical information from subsequent diagnosis generation improved accuracy compared with conventional zero-shot chain-of-thought prompting ( Sonoda et al., 2025 ) . A two-stage diagnostic framework in which a distinct verification stage was introduced between the preliminary and final diagnoses also produced moderate, model-dependent improvements on MedQA and NEJM cases, while increasing answer consistency and reducing the frequency of several reasoning errors ( Shao and Zhang, 2025 ) . However, the evidence remains heterogeneous. Prompts designed to imitate intuitive, analytical, Bayesian, or differential-diagnostic styles of physician reasoning did not produce consistent accuracy gains, particularly for stronger models ( Savage et al., 2024 ) . More generally, the presence of an elaborate textual rationale should not be treated as evidence that the internal process leading to the answer was itself correct: chain-of-thought explanations can retrospectively rationalize decisions that were in fact driven by information not acknowledged in the explanation ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) . Structured clinical reasoning should therefore be evaluated as a distinct empirical intervention rather than assumed to be superior merely because the response is longer or appears more “physician-like.”
blocks.zh: 提高LLM性能的一种方法是明确安排推理过程. 在放射学任务中,将临床信息的结构与随后的诊断生成区分开来,与传统的零发链思维导出相比,提高了准确性(Sonoda等人,2025年)。 在初步诊断和最后诊断之间引入一个不同的核查阶段的两阶段诊断框架,也对MedQA和NEJM病例进行了温和的、依赖模型的改进,同时提高了答案的一致性并减少了若干推理错误的频率(Shao和Zhang,2025年)。 然而,证据仍然多种多样。 旨在模仿直觉、分析、巴耶斯语或医生推理的差分诊断风格的提示没有产生一致的准确性增益,特别是对于更强的模型(Savage等,2024年)。 更一般地说,存在详尽的文字理由不应被作为导致答案的内部过程本身是正确的证据:思维链解释可以追溯性地使决定合理化,而事实上这些决定是由解释中未承认的信息所驱动(Turpin等人,2023年)。 因此,结构化的临床推理应作为一种独特的经验性干预加以评价,而不应仅仅因为反应时间较长或看起来更像“物理学家”。 “

blocks.en: A second approach is to distribute analysis across multiple agents representing different medical specialties. Its natural clinical analogue is the multidisciplinary team (MDT), in which specialists from different disciplines contribute complementary information to diagnosis and treatment planning. Studies of real-world MDTs, particularly in oncology, suggest that team discussion can alter diagnosis and management, although the magnitude of the effect varies substantially across studies and depends on information completeness, team structure, workload, leadership, and case complexity ( Lamb et al., 2011 ; Basta et al., 2017 ; Kočo et al., 2021 ; Soukup et al., 2020 ) . This logic has already been transferred to LLM-based systems. MDAgents dynamically selects between individual and collaborative modes depending on estimated medical complexity ( Kim et al., 2024 ) . Multi-Agent Conversation (MAC) employs multiple physician agents and a supervising agent that iteratively discuss clinical cases ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Model Confrontation and Collaboration (MCC) implements structured debate among heterogeneous LLMs ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . EvoMDT combines specialized agents, retrieval, and a coordinating component ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . These systems demonstrate the feasibility of multi-agent medical reasoning and motivate the use of a multidisciplinary LLM council, but they do not by themselves establish that inter-agent interaction is the causal source of performance improvements.
blocks.zh: 第二种办法是在代表不同医学专业的多种药剂之间分发分析。 其自然临床模拟是多学科团队(MDT),其中来自不同学科的专家为诊断和治疗规划提供补充信息. 对现实世界的 mDTs的研究表明,特别是肿瘤学方面的研究,团队讨论可以改变诊断和管理,尽管影响的程度在不同的研究中差异很大,取决于信息的完整性,团队结构,工作量,领导力和案件的复杂性(Lamb等人,2011年;Basta等人,2017年;Kočo等人,2021年;Soukup等人,2020年). 这个逻辑已经被转移到基于LLM的系统中. MDAgents根据估计的医疗复杂程度在个人模式和合作模式之间动态选择(Kim等,2024年). 多方代理商(MAC)雇用了多方医师代理和反复讨论临床病例的监管代理(Chen等,2025年). 模型对抗与合作(MCC)在各种有限责任公司之间进行有条理的辩论(Sun等人,2026年)。 EvoMDT结合了专门的代理,检索,以及协调组件(Liu等,2026a.). 这些系统证明了多代理医学推理的可行性并激励使用多学科的LLM理事会,但它们本身并不确定代理间互动是性能改善的因果来源.

blocks.en: This distinction is particularly important because multi-agent systems generally consume more computational resources than a single generation. Repeated sampling and self-consistency can improve reasoning performance without any message exchange between agents ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , while Self-Refine improves responses through repeated cycles of critique and revision performed by the same model ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) . In non-medical settings, multi-agent debate has improved reasoning quality and factual accuracy ( Du et al., 2024 ) ; however, compute-matched analyses suggest that its advantage over self-consistency may be substantially smaller than its advantage over a single model response produced without iterative critique or inter-agent exchange ( Wunderlich et al., 2026 ) . Deliberation itself may also introduce new classes of errors: consensus pressure can suppress a correct minority position, motivating consensus-free and trajectory-aware approaches ( Cui et al., 2026 ) . Role assignment constitutes another independent variable. Specialized physician roles are intuitively appealing, yet studies of role and persona prompting indicate that assigning a role label alone does not guarantee improved objective performance and may make outputs sensitive to clinically irrelevant persona attributes ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Luz de Araujo et al., 2025 ) . A rigorous medical evaluation should therefore attempt to disentangle the effects of additional sampling, role diversity, aggregation, and inter-agent interaction itself.
blocks.zh: 这种区分特别重要,因为多代理系统一般比一代人消耗更多的计算资源. 重复采样和自相容性可以改善推理性能,无需在代理商之间进行任何信息交换(Wang等,2023年),而自相通则通过同一种模式(Madaan等,2023年)的反复批判和修正周期来改进反应. 在非医疗环境下,多代理商辩论提高了推理质量和事实准确性(Du等,2024年);然而,计算匹配的分析表明,它相对于自我一致性的优势可能大大小于它相对于单一模型反应的优势,没有迭代批评或代理商间交流(Wunderlich等,2026年)。 考虑本身也可能引入新的错误类别:共识压力可以压制少数群体的正确立场,促使采取没有共识和了解轨迹的办法(Cui等人,2026年)。 角色分配是另一个独立的变量。 专门的医生角色具有直觉的吸引力,但是对角色和人物的提示性研究表明,仅仅给角色贴上标签并不能保证客观表现的改善,而且可能使产出对临床上无关的人的属性敏感(郑等,2024;Luz de Araujo等,2025)。 因此,严格的医学评价应试图将更多的抽样、角色多样性、汇总和代理人间互动本身的影响分清。

blocks.en: A separate challenge is how quality should be evaluated. Contemporary studies of medical LLMs increasingly rely on physician-developed rubrics rather than diagnostic agreement alone ( Cabral et al., 2024 ; Goh et al., 2024 ) . Scalable automated evaluation methods are also emerging: LLMEval-Med combines expert-designed checklists with LLM-as-a-judge evaluation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , MedThink-Bench evaluates expert-curated clinical reasoning trajectories using reference-informed LLM judging ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , and studies of clinical summarization have reported high agreement between some reasoning models and physician evaluators ( Croxford et al., 2025 ) . These findings make automated evaluation a promising measurement tool, but they do not eliminate the need for physician reference ratings, criterion-specific validation, or analysis of judge-model bias and stability.
blocks.zh: 另一个挑战是如何评价质量。 医学法学硕士学位的当代研究越来越依赖医生开发的课程,而不是仅仅依靠诊断协议(Cabral等,2024;Goh等,2024)。 也正在出现可扩展的自动化评价方法:LLMEval-Med将专家设计的清单与LLM-as-judge评价相结合(Zhang等,2025年),MedThink-Bench利用参考信息LLM判断(Zhou等,2026年)评价专家精准的临床推理轨迹,临床汇总研究报告称,一些推理模型与医生评估师之间达成了高度一致(Croxford等,2025年)。 这些结论使自动评价成为有希望的衡量工具,但并不消除医生参考评级、具体标准验证或法官模型偏差和稳定性分析的必要性。

blocks.en: In this study, we develop a benchmark of LLM-generated clinical second opinions using 300 published NEJM cases from the NEJM-MedQA diagnostic-reasoning dataset ( Savage et al., 2024 ) . Response format, inference method, role composition, and model choice are treated as separate comparison dimensions. The benchmark has two evaluation checkpoints. At the first checkpoint, every case-specific clinical role produces an independent, standalone second opinion. At the second, all role-specific opinions are provided to an interactive multidisciplinary consilium that synthesizes a case-level final opinion through iterative review and revision. The interactive consilium protocol provides a fixed synthesis stage across these comparisons. This design supports controlled comparisons without requiring benchmark users to reproduce one fixed generation architecture. A fixed set of 110 cases is used for physician annotation and judge calibration, the remaining 190 cases are reserved for held-out evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们利用NEJM-MedQA诊断-推理数据集(Savage等,2024年)中发表的300个NEJM病例,制定了LLM生成的临床第二意见的基准. 反应格式,推论方法,角色构成,和模型选择被作为单独的比较维度处理. 该基准有两个评价检查站。 在第一个检查站,每个针对具体病例的临床角色都产生独立的,独立的第二个意见. 第二,所有具体角色的意见都提供给一个互动的多学科集合体,通过迭接式审查和修订来综合案例层面的最终意见. 交互同位素协议为这些比较提供了固定的合成阶段. 这种设计支持可控比较,而不需要基准用户复制一个固定生成架构. 一套固定的110个病例用于医生的注释和法官的校准,其余190个案例留作暂停评估。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are: 1. a benchmark that evaluates role-specific opinions and final consilium reports as distinct clinical products on the same cases 2. a multidimensional clinical-quality framework that separates factual grounding, problem prioritization, data use, reasoning coherence, differential diagnosis, final-conclusion quality, management, and safety 3. controlled comparison of model identity, response structure, and synthesis stage together with deliberation dynamics and inference requirements 4. a physician-developed rubric and criterion-wise calibration of an LLM Judge for scalable evaluation of open-ended clinical second opinions
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是: 1. 将特定角色意见和最终缩写报告作为同一病例的独特临床产品加以评价的基准 2. 多层面临床质量框架,将事实基础、问题优先排序、数据使用、推理一致性、差异诊断、最终结论质量、管理和安全区分开来 3. 对模型身份、反应结构和综合阶段的有控制地比较,连同审议动态和推论要求 4. 由医生开发的LLM法官的标语和标准校准,用于对开放式临床第二次意见进行可扩展评价

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Second Opinions and Multidisciplinary Teams
blocks.zh: 2.1 第二点意见和多学科小组

blocks.en: In clinical practice, second opinions are evaluated by more than whether they change a diagnosis. A systematic review of patient-initiated second opinions showed that repeat expert assessment can lead to changes in diagnostic formulation, treatment, and patient satisfaction Payne et al. (2014) . An analysis of a national second-opinion program likewise demonstrated that disagreement with the original assessment may involve both diagnosis and management Meyer et al. (2015) . These findings support evaluating a second opinion as a multidimensional clinical product rather than solely by agreement on the final diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 在临床实践中,第二意见被评价的不仅仅是它们是否改变了诊断. 对患者发起的第二次意见的系统审查表明,重复的专家评估可能导致诊断制剂、治疗和患者满意度的变化(2014年)。 对国家第二意见方案的分析也表明,与最初评估的分歧可能涉及诊断和管理Meyer等人(2015年)。 这些调查结果支持将第二种意见评价为多层面临床产品,而不是仅仅通过就最后诊断达成一致意见。

blocks.en: A similar logic emerges from the literature on multidisciplinary teams (MDTs). Systematic reviews in oncology show that MDT discussion frequently changes management, although its effect is heterogeneous and depends on workflow organization, the quality and completeness of the available information, and team composition Lamb et al. (2011) ; Basta et al. (2017) ; Kočo et al. (2021) . Observational studies of team decision-making further suggest that collective deliberation should not be equated with a guarantee of correctness Soukup et al. (2020) . Accordingly, consensus itself cannot serve as a surrogate endpoint for quality in a multidisciplinary LLM council. Related medical-AI evaluation work formalizes the same concern by comparing algorithmic diagnoses against multiple expert opinions rather than a single majority label, thereby accounting explicitly for inter-expert variability Kopanichuk et al. (2026) . More informative questions concern which facts, hypotheses, investigations, risks, and treatment options are preserved, revised, or lost during the process of council deliberation and synthesis.
blocks.zh: 关于多学科小组的文献也出现了类似的逻辑。 肿瘤学方面的系统审查表明,MDT讨论经常会改变管理,尽管其影响各不相同并取决于工作流程安排、现有信息的质量和完整性以及Lamb等人(2011年);Basta等人(2017年);Kočo等人(2021年)。 对团队决策的观察研究进一步表明,集体审议不应等同于对Soukup等人(2020年)的正确性保证。 因此,协商一致本身不能作为多学科LLM理事会质量的替代终点。 相关的医学-AI评估工作将同样的关切正式化,将算法诊断与多种专家意见相比较,而不是单一多数的标签,从而明确说明专家之间的可变性。 内容更加翔实的问题涉及哪些事实、假设、调查、风险和治疗选择在理事会审议和综合过程中得到保留、修订或丢失。

blocks.en: 2.2 LLMs on Complex Clinical Cases: From Diagnosis to the Full Decision Trajectory
blocks.zh: 2.2 关于复杂临床病例的法学硕士学位:从诊断到全面判断

blocks.en: Early studies showed that contemporary LLMs can solve difficult diagnostic problems based on published clinical cases. Kanjee et al. evaluated GPT-4 on diagnostic challenges, while Cabral et al. compared model-generated clinical reasoning with physician reasoning Kanjee et al. (2023) ; Cabral et al. (2024) . Similar findings have been reported in series of complex case reports and clinical scenarios Hirosawa et al. (2024) ; Rutledge (2024) . The AMIE study extended this line of work to 302 challenging published case reports and a physician-assistance setting, demonstrating the potential of LLMs both for differential diagnosis and for supporting physicians McDuff et al. (2025) . Complementary clinical AI systems have addressed narrower but clinically important tasks, including diagnosis prediction from longitudinal health records and automated mapping of free-text diagnoses to ICD codes Umerenkov et al. (2025) ; Nesterov et al. (2025) . These systems illustrate the broader clinical-decision-support context in which generated second opinions would operate.
blocks.zh: 早期的研究表明,当代LLMS可以根据已公布的临床病例解决困难的诊断问题. Kanjee等人评价了GPT-4的诊断挑战,而Cabral等人则将模型产生的临床推理与医生推理Kanjee等人(2023年);Cabral等人(2024年)进行比较. 在一系列复杂的病例报告和Hirosawa等人(2024年);Rutledge(2024年)的临床假设中也报告了类似的发现。 AMIE研究将这项工作扩展到302项挑战性已公布的个案报告和医生援助环境的工作,表明LLMS在差别诊断和支持医生McDuff等人(2025年)方面的潜力。 补充性临床人工智能系统已处理了范围较窄但临床上很重要的任务,包括从纵向健康记录中作出诊断预测,以及将自由文本诊断自动映射到国际疾病分类编码Umerenkov等(2025);Nesterov等(2025)。 这些系统说明了产生第二次意见的更广泛的临床决策支持背景。

blocks.en: High diagnostic accuracy, however, is not equivalent to comprehensive response quality. Hager et al. developed MIMIC-CDM using 2,400 real-world cases and evaluated not only diagnosis but also information gathering, interpretation of laboratory findings, adherence to diagnostic and treatment recommendations, robustness to the order and amount of available information, and instruction-following ability Hager et al. (2024) . Their results indicate that strong diagnostic accuracy does not guarantee adequate performance across the full clinical decision-making process. Similarly, a randomized trial of management reasoning found that GPT-4 assistance can improve physician performance on open-ended patient-care tasks, but that its effect needs to be evaluated separately from diagnostic accuracy and with consideration of interaction time Goh et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 然而,高诊断准确性不等于全面反应的质量。 Hager等 (英语). 利用2 400个真实世界病例开发了MIMIC-CDM,并不仅评价了诊断,而且还评价了信息收集、实验室结果的解释、遵守诊断和治疗建议、坚固掌握现有信息的顺序和数量,以及遵循Hager等人(2024年)能力的指导。 其结果表明,诊断的准确性强,不能保证整个临床决策过程的适足性能。 同样,对管理推理的随机试验发现,GPT-4协助可以改善医生在开放式病人护理任务上的性能,但其影响需要与诊断准确性分开评估,并考虑互动时间Goh等人(2025年).

blocks.en: In 2026, Medieval introduced a broad multidisciplinary blinded expert evaluation framework for diagnosis and management across 685 real and simulated clinical questions, including explicit recording of fabricated medical facts Chen et al. (2026b) . This work is particularly relevant as a precedent for multidimensional evaluation of free-form clinical responses. Reliability also requires recognizing when the available evidence is insufficient: uncertainty-aware selective-prediction methods for medical text can improve diagnostic reliability by allowing a system to abstain from uncertain decisions Vazhentsev et al. (2026) . Taken together, these studies support separately assessing case-fact utilization, quality of explanation, differential diagnosis, diagnostic workup, treatment, risk, uncertainty, and safety rather than relying on a single aggregate measure of diagnostic accuracy.
blocks.zh: 2026年,中世纪在685个真实和模拟的临床问题中引入了广泛的多学科失明专家诊断和管理评价框架,包括明确记录捏造的医疗事实. 陈等 (2026b). 这项工作作为对免费临床反应进行多层面评价的先例特别重要。 可靠性还要求当现有证据不充分时予以承认:医疗文本的不确定性意识选择性预测方法可以通过允许一个系统避免作出不确定的决定而提高诊断可靠性(Vazhentsev等)(2026年)。 综合起来,这些研究支持单独评估个案的利用情况、解释的质量、差别诊断、诊断工作、治疗、风险、不确定性和安全性,而不是依赖单一的诊断准确性总衡量标准。

blocks.en: 2.3 Structured Clinical Reasoning, Verification, and Test-Time Inference
blocks.zh: 2.3 结构临床理性、核实和试验时间推论

blocks.en: Medical studies of structured prompting suggest that the format of reasoning can affect output quality even when the underlying model remains unchanged. Sonoda et al. compared direct and structured prompting on the same radiology cases and observed improved diagnostic performance with an explicit clinical-reasoning structure Sonoda et al. (2025) . Savage et al. showed that diagnostic reasoning prompts can elicit more interpretable clinical rationales, although the generated chain of thought should not be interpreted as a faithful record of the model’s latent internal reasoning process Savage et al. (2024) . Shao and Zhang employed a two-stage framework with predefined verification steps on MedQA and NEJM cases and found that an explicit verification stage could improve diagnostic performance and uncertainty handling Shao and Zhang (2025) .
blocks.zh: 对结构化催化的医学研究表明,即使基本模型保持不变,推理的格式也会影响产出质量. 索诺达等. 比较直接和有条不紊地引起同一放射病例,并观察到诊断性能的改善,具有明确的临床推理结构Sonoda等人(2025年)。 萨维奇等. 诊断推理提示可以引出更可解释的临床推理,尽管产生的思维链不应被解释为该模型潜在内部推理过程的忠实记录 Savage等 (2024). 肖和张采用两个阶段框架,对MedQA和NEJM案件采取预先确定的核查步骤,并发现明确的核查阶段可以改善对肖和张的诊断性能和不确定性处理(2025).

blocks.en: Strong inference-time baselines are essential for interpreting such gains. Self-consistency demonstrates that simply increasing the number of independent generations and subsequently aggregating them can itself improve reasoning performance Wang et al. (2023) . Self-Refine demonstrates the value of iterative self-critique and answer revision by a single model Madaan et al. (2023) . Therefore, when a structured or council-based condition uses more model calls, more tokens, or additional critique stages, superior performance cannot automatically be attributed to the structure or to inter-agent interaction. General-domain equal-compute studies of test-time scaling further highlight the importance of comparing debate, mixtures or ensembles, and self-consistency under comparable inference budgets Wunderlich et al. (2026) . Recent medical work has further treated the decision pipeline itself as an inference-time optimization target, using LLM-guided evolution to improve accuracy–cost trade-offs in interactive consultation and other clinical decision tasks Sviridov et al. (2026) . Although these findings are methodological rather than direct clinical evidence, they provide an important basis for designing appropriate baseline comparisons.
blocks.zh: 强有力的推断时间基线对于解释这些收益至关重要。 自我一致表明,仅仅增加独立世代的数量,然后将它们汇总,就可以提高王等的推理性能(2023年). Self-Refine演示了由单一模型Madaan等人(2023年)进行迭接自律和回答修改的价值. 因此,当一个结构化或基于理事会的条件使用更多的模型调用,更多的符号,或额外的批评阶段时,优异的性能不能自动归因于结构或代理人间的互动. 对试验时间缩放的通用域等同计算研究进一步突出了在可比推论预算Wunderlich等人(2026年)下比较辩论、混合物或组合以及自我一致性的重要性。 最近的医疗工作进一步将决策管道本身作为推论时间优化的目标,利用LLM引导的演化,提高交互磋商和其他临床决策任务的准确性-成本取舍(2026年)。 尽管这些结论是方法性而非直接临床证据,但它们为设计适当的基线比较提供了重要的基础.

blocks.en: 2.4 Medical Multi-Agent Systems and the Computational Confounding Problem
blocks.zh: 2.4 医疗多代理系统和计算难题

blocks.en: Multi-agent architectures in medicine are developing rapidly. MedAgents organizes LLM roles as a set of discipline-specific experts that first provide independent assessments, then engage in multiple rounds of discussion, and finally converge on a shared decision Tang et al. (2024) . MDAgents adaptively selects a solo, group, or more complex collaboration mode based on estimated task complexity and achieves strong results across several medical benchmark settings Kim et al. (2024) . MAC employs multiple doctor agents and a supervisor to diagnose rare diseases and subsequently recommend additional investigations Chen et al. (2025) . More recent systems extend this paradigm through confrontation and debate or structured MDT-style orchestration Sun et al. (2026) ; Liu et al. (2026a) . Related deployed systems include CLARITY, which combines structured dialogue control with collaborative LLM agents for patient routing, clinical consultation, and triage Shaposhnikov et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 医学领域的多剂建筑发展迅速. MedAgents组织LLM角色是一组针对学科的专家,他们首先提供独立的评估,然后进行多轮讨论,最后就共同决定Tang等人(2024年)达成共识. MDAgents根据任务复杂程度的估计,适应性地选择了独奏,分组,或更复杂的协作模式,并在多个医疗基准设置中取得了强劲的成果. 金等 (2024) (中文(简体) ). 麻省理工学院雇用了多名医生和一位主管来诊断罕见的疾病,随后建议进行更多的调查。 陈等 (2025). 较近期的系统通过对抗和辩论或结构化的MDT风格的管弦乐Sun等(2026年);刘等(2026年a年)来扩展这一范式. 相关的部署系统包括CLARITY,它将结构化的对话控制与协作的LLM剂结合起来,用于患者的路由,临床会诊,以及分管Shaposhnikov等人(2025年).

blocks.en: These studies establish the feasibility of multi-agent approaches but do not demonstrate that interaction itself is responsible for performance gains. A multi-agent arm typically introduces several changes simultaneously: more generations, larger context windows, a supervisor or aggregator, different prompting strategies, and in some cases retrieval or structured knowledge. MDAgents also modifies the workflow itself according to case complexity, meaning that its group mode does not cleanly isolate the effect of interaction Kim et al. (2024) . In a large benchmark of agentic clinical decision systems, Liu et al. found only moderate accuracy improvements over standalone LLMs despite more than a tenfold increase in token usage and more than a twofold increase in latency Liu et al. (2026b) . These findings make inference cost and compute-matched controls essential for interpreting the performance of a multidisciplinary LLM council.
blocks.zh: 这些研究确定了多种代理方法的可行性,但没有表明互动本身对绩效收益负责. 多代理臂通常会同时引入几个变化:多代,上下文窗口较大,主管或聚合器,不同的导出策略,以及在某些情况下检索或结构化的知识. MDAgents还根据案件复杂度来修改工作流程本身,指其组模式不能干净地隔离互动Kim等(2024)的效果. . 以大型基准的药剂临床决策体系中,刘等. 尽管象征性使用量增加了十倍多,而Liu等人(2026年b)则增加了两倍多,但仅发现相对于独立的有限责任公司而言,精确度略有提高。 这些结论使推断成本和计算相应控制对解释多学科LLM理事会的业绩至关重要。

blocks.en: Role labels should likewise not be equated with validated medical specialization. In most medical-agent studies, specialization is induced through prompting rather than through dedicated training and external validation of agent competence. General-domain studies of persona prompting have produced mixed results, further limiting strong claims that assigning a specialist role automatically creates stable domain-specific expertise Zheng et al. (2024) ; Luz de Araujo et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 同样,不应将角色标签等同于经证实的专业医学。 在大多数医疗代理研究中,专业化是通过激励而不是通过专门培训和外部鉴定代理能力诱导的。 关于个人诱导的一般领域研究产生了好坏参半的结果,进一步限制了强烈的主张,即指定专家角色自动产生稳定的特定领域专门知识Zheng等人(2024年);Luz de Araujo等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: 2.5 Human–AI Collaboration, Automation Bias, and Clinical Safety
blocks.zh: 2.5 人类-AI协作、自动化比斯和临床安全

blocks.en: Even a strong standalone LLM does not guarantee improvement in a physician–AI team. In a randomized diagnostic trial, access to GPT-4 did not produce a statistically significant improvement in the primary diagnostic-reasoning outcome compared with conventional resources, despite strong exploratory performance of GPT-4 alone Goh et al. (2024) . In a subsequent randomized management trial, physicians using GPT-4 achieved higher scores on patient-care tasks but required more time, and the physician-plus-GPT condition did not automatically outperform GPT alone Goh et al. (2025) . In a 2026 randomized controlled trial, both first-opinion and second-opinion AI workflows improved diagnostic performance relative to conventional resources, yet the collaborative workflow again did not demonstrate automatic superiority over the AI-alone condition Everett et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 即使是一个强大的独立的LLM也不能保证医生团队的改善. 在随机诊断试验中,尽管光是Goh等人(2024年)的GPT-4就具有很强的探索性,但与传统资源相比,GPT-4的获取在统计学上并没有产生显著改善。 在之后的随机化管理试验中,使用GPT-4的医生在病人护理任务上取得了更高的分数,但需要更多的时间,医生-加-GPT的病情并没有自动超过GPT单独Goh等人(2025年). 在2026年的随机可控试验中,"一通"和"二通"的AI工作流程都相对于常规资源改善了诊断性能,然而合作工作流程再次没有表现出自动优于AI独行状态Everett等 (2026).

blocks.en: Systematic reviews and meta-analyses published in 2026 further support the heterogeneity of human–LLM collaboration. For several diagnostic endpoints, LLM-assisted clinicians outperform clinicians alone on average, but effect sizes vary across models, study designs, and case types, while risks of bias and publication bias remain substantial Wang et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2026a) . These studies concern clinician outcomes and human–AI interaction, which are outside the scope of the present benchmark; here, physician ratings are used as an expert reference for the quality of the generated material itself.
blocks.zh: 2026年发表的系统性评论和元分析进一步支持了人类-LLM合作的异质性. 对于几个诊断端点,LLM协助的临床医生平均仅优于临床医生,但效果大小因模型、研究设计和病例类型而异,而Wang等人(2026年);Chen等人(2026年a)则仍然有很大的偏差和出版偏差。 这些研究涉及临床医生的结果和人类-AI的互动,这些结果和互动不属于本基准的范围;在这方面,医生的评级被用作所生成材料本身质量的专家参考。

blocks.en: A separate concern is overreliance on incorrect AI advice. In a randomized vignette study, Jabbour et al. found that systematically biased AI recommendations reduced clinicians’ diagnostic accuracy, and visual explanations did not eliminate this effect Jabbour et al. (2023) . Safety evaluation should therefore account not only for factual or therapeutic errors in an LLM-generated response, but also for the possibility that a plausibly formulated second opinion may shift a physician’s decision in the wrong direction.
blocks.zh: 另一个关切是过度依赖错误的大赦国际建议。 在一项随机的vignette研究中,Jabbour等. 发现有系统性偏见的AI建议降低了临床医生的诊断准确性,而视觉解释并没有消除这种效果Jabbour等人(2023年). 因此,安全评价不仅应当考虑到LLM产生的反应中的事实或治疗错误,而且还应当考虑到合理拟订的第二种意见可能将医生的决定转向错误的方向。

blocks.en: LLM-generated explanations can themselves influence clinical acceptance: Umerenkov et al. found that explanations increased physicians’ agreement with presented diagnoses while also containing nontrivial errors Umerenkov et al. (2023) . Persuasiveness and clinical correctness should therefore be evaluated separately.
blocks.zh: LLM生成的解释本身会影响临床接受: 乌梅伦科夫等. Umerenkov等人(2023年)认为,解释增加了医生对诊断意见的同意,同时也含有非三角错误。 因此,应单独评价劝导性和临床正确性。

blocks.en: 2.6 LLM-as-a-Judge and Physician Expert Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.6 LLM-as-a-法官和物理专家评价

blocks.en: Automated evaluation of free-form medical responses is attractive because physician review is expensive and variable, but the available evidence does not support treating LLM-based evaluation as an unconditional surrogate for ground truth. Croxford et al. reported high agreement between LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation in the relatively constrained task of clinical summarization Croxford et al. (2025) . Zhou et al. likewise investigated automated expert-level evaluation of medical reasoning Zhou et al. (2026) . More recent studies, however, suggest substantial task- and criterion-dependence. In a multicenter study of real de-identified cases, ratings from more than 400 physicians differed substantially from matched AI evaluators Shi et al. (2026) . Williams et al. compared five LLM judges with clinicians and found that even the best-performing judge reproduced human ratings for only a subset of eleven criteria, while jury-style aggregation produced only limited improvements in agreement Williams et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 对免费形式的医疗反应进行自动评价是有吸引力的,因为医生审查费用昂贵且可变,但现有证据不支持将基于LLM的评价作为地面真相的无条件代孕. Croxford等人报告说,LLM-as-a-judge与人类评价在临床总结Croxford等人(2025年)这一相对受限的任务上达成了高度一致. 周克等同样调查了医学推理专家级自动评价 周克等 (2026). 然而,最近的研究表明,任务和标准依赖性很大。 在一项对实际已查明病例的多中心研究中,400多位医生的评级与相应的AI评价者有很大不同。 史等 (2026) (中文(简体) ). 威廉斯等编. 比较5名LLM法官与临床医生,发现即使表现最好的法官也只复制了11个标准的子集的人的评级,而陪审团式的汇总在协议Williams等人(2026年)中只产生有限的改进.

blocks.en: These findings motivate a more conservative validation framework: physicians remain the primary expert reference, while an LLM judge should be validated against physician ratings separately for each evaluation criterion. Agreement on one dimension, such as factual completeness, should not be assumed to generalize to treatment appropriateness, safety, or uncertainty calibration.
blocks.zh: 这些结论激励了一个更为保守的验证框架:医生仍然是主要的专家参考,而LLM法官应当根据医生对每项评价标准的评级分别进行验证。 就事实完整性等一个方面达成协议,不应被假定为一般地适用于治疗的适当性、安全性或不确定性的校准。

blocks.en: 2.7 Positioning of the Present Study
blocks.zh: 2.7 本研究报告的立场

blocks.en: The closest prior studies address individual pairs of components in our setting, but we did not identify a published study that, on the same set of real published clinical cases, evaluates standalone role-specific second opinions and subsequent multidisciplinary synthesis while independently varying response structure, sampling and aggregation, and council interaction, and while validating an LLM judge against physicians criterion by criterion. Sonoda et al. provide a direct precedent for a same-case free-form versus structured comparison, whereas MAC, MDAgents, and other medical multi-agent systems compare single- and multi-agent variants without exposing all intermediate opinions as benchmark units or fully separating interaction from inference budget Sonoda et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2025) ; Kim et al. (2024) . Accordingly, the contribution of the present study is not a presumption that multidisciplinary deliberation is intrinsically superior, but an empirical decomposition of the stages and design choices that produce a clinical second opinion.
blocks.zh: 最近的前期研究涉及我们环境中的单个成对成分,但我们没有找到一份已发表的研究,该研究在同一组实际公布的临床病例上,评价单独的角色特定第二点意见和随后的多学科综合,同时独立地改变反应结构,取样和汇总,以及理事会互动,同时根据标准验证一位LLM判断员. 索诺达等. 提供了同案自由式与结构化比较的直接先例,而MAC、MDAgents和其他医疗多剂系统则比较了单剂和多剂的变体,而没有将所有中间意见作为基准单位,或将相互作用与推论预算Sonoda等(2025);Chen等(2025);Kim等(2024)。 因此,本研究的贡献不是假定多学科审议在本质上是优越的,而是对产生临床第二意见的阶段和设计选择进行经验分解.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Study Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 研究设计

blocks.en: We conducted a benchmark-development and evaluation study using published, diagnostically resolved clinical cases. The generation pipeline comprised three stages: (i) case-specific assignment of clinical roles, (ii) independent role-specific analysis before consilium (the pre-consilium stage), and (iii) multidisciplinary synthesis (the consilium stage). The dataset’s separate Answer field was not supplied to the generation models and was reserved for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们利用已公布的、经诊断解决的临床病例,进行了一项基准发展和评价研究。 生成管道由三个阶段组成:(一) 临床角色的具体个案分配;(二) 在同位素前的独立角色特定分析(同位素前阶段);(三) 多学科合成(同位素阶段)。 该数据集单独的Answer字段没有提供给生成模型,而是留给评价使用。

blocks.en: Physician evaluation comprised three independently scored components (Figure 1 ). First, physicians evaluated the clinical reasoning within the relevant role-specific pre-consilium output, excluding its clinical opinion. Second, they evaluated the clinical opinion of the same role-specific output. Third, they evaluated the final case-level consilium conclusion. The same eight quality criteria were applied independently to each component using a 0-3 scale, a score assigned to one component was not carried over to another. Three additional ratings-panel adequacy, case complexity, and overall quality across all stages - were assigned once per case assessment.
blocks.zh: 物理评价包括三个独立得分的组成部分(图1)。 首先,医生评估了相关角色特定前consilium输出中的临床推理,排除了其临床意见. 第二,他们评价了同一角色特定产出的临床意见. 第三,他们评价了最后的个案级连结结论。 同样的八项质量标准是独立适用于每个组件的,使用0-3分制,分配给一个组件的分数没有结转到另一个组件. 每个案件评估后再分配三个评级小组,即适当性、案件复杂性和所有阶段的总体质量。

blocks.en: The reference pipeline supported two pre-consilium prompt conditions—free-form narrative responses and structured, schema-constrained responses with expanded clinical-reasoning guidance—and two inference topologies (single and N + 1 N+1 ). All multidisciplinary synthesis used the interactive consilium protocol described below. The conditions included in each analysis were specified prospectively. Model identifiers, prompts, generation parameters, and prerequisite artifacts were recorded for reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 参考管道支持两个预缩合物即时条件——自由形式叙述性反应和结构化、有计划限制的反应,同时扩大临床理由指导——和两个推论地貌(单一和N+1 N+1)。 所有多学科综合都使用了下文所描述的交互式同位素协议。 每项分析中所包含的条件都是在将来具体列明的。 模型识别器、提示、生成参数和先决条件的文物被记录下来,以便复制。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Generation and physician-evaluation workflow. Case-specific roles produced independent pre-consilium opinions before interactive multidisciplinary synthesis. Physicians scored role-specific clinical reasoning, role-specific clinical opinion, and the final consilium conclusion as three separate components using the same eight 0–3 criteria. Panel adequacy, case complexity, and overall quality across all stages were rated separately.
blocks.zh: 图1:生成和医生评价工作流程。 具体案例的作用在互动的多学科综合之前产生了独立的预总结意见。 医生对角色特定临床推理,角色特定临床意见,以及最终的同位素结论进行打分,是使用相同的8个0–3标准作为三个独立的组件. 小组的充分性、案件的复杂性和各个阶段的总体质量分别加以评定。

blocks.en: 3.2 NEJM Clinical Case Dataset, Selection Rationale, and Prespecified Split
blocks.zh: 3.2 NEJM 临床病例数据集、选择理由和预先指定的分块

blocks.en: We used the nejm_test configuration of NEJM–MedQA, which mirrors the supplementary data of Savage et al. ( Savage et al., 2024 ; Link, 2024 ) . The source dataset includes 300 extended clinicopathological cases selected from 310 recent Case Records after excluding ten without a definitive diagnosis or within the applicable context limit ( Brinkmann et al., 2024 ; Savage et al., 2024 ) . We used 300 DOI-unique cases published in 2015–2023. Case descriptions contained a median of 1,036 words (IQR, 852–1,197; range, 231–2,167).
blocks.zh: 我们使用了NEJM-MedQA的 nijm_test配置,它反映了Savage等人的补充数据. (Savage等,2024;Link,2024). 源数据集包括从最近的310个病例记录中挑选的300个扩大的临床病理学病例,其中排除了10个病例,但没有经过明确的诊断,或者在适用的上下文限度内(Brinkmann等人,2024;Savage等人,2024)。 我们使用了在2015–2023年公布的300个DOI-独特案例. 案例描述的中位数为1 036个字(IQR,852–1,197;范围为231–2,167)。

blocks.en: We retained the clinical presentation and normalized metadata but removed source-study instructions, examples, prior model responses, and grades. The separate Answer field was withheld during generation and used only for evaluation. Role assignment and both response conditions received the same DOI, title, and case description; the consilium received an identifier-stripped case, the fixed role opinions, and the review history.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了临床表述和规范的元数据,但删除了源研究说明、实例、先前的模型答复和等级。 单独的Answer字段在生成时被扣取并仅用于评价. 角色分配和两个响应条件都得到了相同的DOI,标题和案例描述;consilium得到了一个识别符号被抽出的案例,固定的角色意见,以及审查历史.

blocks.en: We chose this corpus because its long, diagnostically resolved narratives support open-ended assessment of reasoning, management, and safety, not only diagnostic agreement. The published diagnosis was used for diagnostic concordance but not as exhaustive ground truth for management. Because Case Records favor unusual and difficult cases, results should not be interpreted as performance in routine practice ( Kanjee et al., 2023 ; Savage et al., 2024 ; McDuff et al., 2025 ; Shao and Zhang, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们之所以选择这一文书,是因为其冗长、诊断性的说明支持对推理、管理和安全,而不仅仅是诊断性协议的开放式评估。 已公布的诊断被用于诊断一致性,但并非管理层的详尽事实。 由于案件记录倾向于不寻常和困难的案件,结果不应被解释为例行实践中的表现(Kanjee等,2023;Savage等,2024;McDuff等,2025;Shao和Zhang,2025)。

blocks.en: Before evaluation, we reused a prespecified fixed DOI manifest defining 110 cases for physician annotation and Judge calibration, the 190-case held-out evaluation cohort was its exact set complement, with source-dataset order preserved. Here, “held-out” means that the 190 evaluation cases were not used for physician annotation or Judge calibration in this study.
blocks.zh: 在评估前,我们重新使用了预先指定的固定的DOI清单,其中界定了110个医生注解和校准病例,190个案例的搁置评价组是其确切的成套补充,保留了源数据集命令。 在此,“搁置”是指本研究中没有将190个评价案例用于医生说明或法官校准。

blocks.en: 3.3 Role Assignment And Independent Role-Specific Second Opinions
blocks.zh: 3.3 角色分配和独立角色 -- -- 特定第二意见

blocks.en: For each case, the configured role-assignment procedure selected between one and five clinical roles, designated one as primary, and provided a brief case-specific rationale for each role and for the panel as a whole. Exact duplicate role names were rejected case-insensitively, and the primary role was required to match one of the selected roles. The primary-role designation was retained as metadata and did not alter subsequent generation: every selected role produced an opinion. Role-specific prompts received the role name but not its selection rationale or primary-role status.
blocks.zh: 对于每个病例,在1至5个临床角色之间选择的配置角色分配程序指定一个为主要角色,并为每个角色和整个小组提供了简要的个案理由。 确切的重复角色名称被忽略了对大小写不敏感,主要角色需要匹配所选角色之一. 主要作用的指定被保留为元数据,不会改变以后的生成:每一个选定的角色都产生一个意见. 具体角色的提示得到了角色名,但没有获得其选择理由或初级角色地位.

blocks.en: Every selected role received the same case input and produced its opinion without seeing the opinions produced for other roles. Consequently, each output could be read and evaluated independently as a second opinion from that prompted clinical perspective. The role-specific outputs were fixed before the consilium and were not regenerated during discussion.
blocks.zh: 每个选定的角色都收到同样的案例投入,并发表了自己的意见,却没有看到为其他角色提出的意见。 因此,每项产出都可以独立阅读和评价,作为促使临床观点的第二个意见。 特定角色的产出在集合之前是固定的,在讨论期间没有再生成.

blocks.en: In the free-form condition, the model produced a self-contained clinical opinion and was instructed to state missing information and assumptions. In the structured condition, the required fields were: subjective and objective information, clinical syndromes and involved mechanisms, differential diagnosis with reasoning, diagnostic and treatment tactics and final clinical opinion. The structured condition combined a prespecified response schema with more detailed clinical-reasoning instructions. Comparisons with the free-form condition therefore reflected the overall difference between the two prompting approaches, rather than the isolated effect of response format.
blocks.zh: 在自由形态条件下,模型产生了自成一体的临床意见并被指示说明缺失的信息和假设. 在结构化条件下,要求的领域是:主观和客观信息、临床综合症和涉及机制、与推理、诊断和治疗策略以及最终临床意见相区别的诊断。 结构条件结合了预先指定的反应计划以及更详细的临床推理说明. 因此,与自由形式条件的比较反映了两种催化方法的总体差异,而不是反应形式的孤立效应。

blocks.en: 3.4 Interactive Multidisciplinary Consilium Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.4 互动的多科化合物议定书

blocks.en: We use consilium to denote structured multidisciplinary review of a clinical case. The reference workflow adapted the five-stage logic of MedAgents from multiple-choice medical question answering to generation of a self-contained clinical second opinion ( Tang et al., 2024 ) . It was an adaptation rather than a literal reproduction: the output was an open-ended clinical report, roles addressed both diagnosis and management, and all role-specific opinions were retained.
blocks.zh: 我们用consilium来表示对临床病例的结构化多学科审查. 参考工作流程从多选择医学问题回答到生成自足的临床第二意见(Tang等,2024),调整了MedAgents的五相逻辑. 这是一种适应性而非文字上的再生:产出是一份开放式的临床报告,角色既涉及诊断,也涉及管理,保留了所有具体角色的意见.

blocks.en: The interactive protocol first synthesized the case and fixed role-specific opinions into a shared report. In each round, every role independently reviewed the current report and returned either a yes vote or a no vote with a clinically relevant critique and proposed revision. From the second round onward, reviewers also received the reviews and moderator decision from the immediately preceding round. If every role voted yes , the controller recorded consensus. Otherwise, the moderator considered the objections, checked them against the case, and either revised the report or recorded that no substantive change was warranted.
blocks.zh: 互动协议首先将案件和固定角色特定意见综合成一份共享报告. 在每一轮中,每个角色都独立地审查了本报告,并以临床上相关的批评和拟议修订结果退回赞成票或反对票。 从第二轮开始,审查人员还收到了前一轮的审查和主持人的决定。 如果每个角色都投了赞成票,控制员记录了共识. 否则,主持人会考虑反对意见,对照案件加以核对,或修改报告,或记录为没有必要作实质性修改。

blocks.en: The cycle ended when all roles accepted the report, the moderator reported no substantive change, a revised report exactly repeated a previously seen report state, or five review rounds were completed. When dissent persisted through the fifth review and the moderator made a substantive revision, that revision was retained at the maximum-round stop without a sixth role vote. The finalizer then received the case, all fixed role-specific opinions, the last retained report, all specialist reviews, and summaries of the moderator’s revision decisions. It produced a self-contained final opinion while retaining unresolved disagreement and uncertainty. The controller recorded the number of completed rounds, consensus status, and stop reason. The full protocol is specified in Algorithm B .
blocks.zh: 周期结束时,所有角色都接受报告,主持人报告说没有实质性改变,订正后的报告完全重复了以前看到的报告情况,或完成了五轮审查。 在第五次审查时持不同意见,主持人也作了实质性修订后,该修订在没有第六场角色表决的情况下被保留在最高轮站. 最终审结者随后收到了案件,所有固定的角色特定意见,最后保留的报告,所有专家审查,以及主持人的修订决定摘要. 它提出了自成一体的最终意见,同时保留了尚未解决的分歧和不确定性。 控制器记录了完成的回合数,共识状态,并停止理性. 完整的协议在算法 B 中指定 。

blocks.en: The final free-form output was a self-contained narrative opinion. The structured output contained a consilium summary, resolved and unresolved disagreements, final differential diagnosis, diagnostic and management plans, safety warnings, final second opinion, and confidence level. Structured voting and termination records were used in both response formats. Complete interactive-consilium reports for the same calibration case are provided for the free-form and structured conditions in Appendices C and D , respectively.
blocks.zh: 最终的自由形式产出是自成一体的叙事意见. 结构化的产出包括:综合摘要、已解决和未解决的分歧、最后的差别诊断、诊断和管理计划、安全警告、最后第二次意见以及信任程度。 结构化的表决和终止记录都以两种答复格式使用。 附录C和D分别提供了同一校正案例的完整互动-压缩报告。

blocks.en: 3.5 Construction of the Physician-Annotation Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.5 建造物理-注释公司

blocks.en: The physician-annotation corpus comprised 110 cases. Each case was processed through both the free-form and structured pipelines using the same finalized role panel.
blocks.zh: 医生说明书包括110个病例。 每个案件都通过自由式管道和结构化管道处理,使用同一个最终确定的角色小组。

blocks.en: Before generating the corpus, we screened open-weight models offered through OpenRouter in July 2026 ( OpenRouter, 2026 ) . Eligibility required public weights, support for structured outputs or reasoning, sufficient context for the longest prompts in our pipeline, reliable provider access, and a feasible projected cost. We selected the four highest-ranked eligible models when the OpenRouter catalogue was sorted by the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.
blocks.zh: 2026年7月(OpenRouter,2026年), 资格要求公众权重、对结构化产出或推理的支持、对管道中最长的提示的充分背景、可靠的供应商准入以及可行的预计成本。 在OpenRouter目录被人工分析智能指数排序时,我们选择了四个排名最高的合格模型.

blocks.en:
GLM-5.2 ( Z.ai, 2026 ) ranked highest and combined a long context window with broad provider availability, so it was assigned to combine the workers’ outputs and conduct the interactive consilium. MiniMax M3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( MiniMaxAI, 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) were the next two eligible models and offered long context windows at comparatively low inference cost. Kimi K2.6 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) was the next-ranked eligible model and added a third independent developer and model family to the worker panel. Thus, the strongest eligible model performed the final synthesis, while the next three provided independent opinions without relying on a single model family. Role assignment and role-specific pre-consilium generation used a 3+1 procedure: the three worker models independently completed each task, and GLM-5.2 consolidated their outputs.
In both pipelines, the pre-consilium opinions were then passed to the interactive consilium. GLM-5.2 generated one response at each step, with a maximum of five review rounds. This produced 110 final consilium conclusions per pipeline.
blocks.zh:
GLM-5.2(Z.ai, 2026年)排名最高,并结合了一个长上下文窗口和广泛的供应商可用性,因此它被分配来结合工人的产出和进行交互相接。 MiniMax M3和DeepSeek-V4-Pro(MiniMaxAI,2026;DeepSeek-AI,2026)是后两个符合条件的模型,并以相对较低的推论成本提供长上下文窗口. Kimi K2.6 (Moonshot AI, 2026年)是次名的合格型号,并在工人小组中增加了第三个独立的开发商和模型家庭. 因此,最强的合格模型完成了最终的合成,而后三个模型则在不依赖单一模型家族的情况下提供了独立的意见. 角色分配和特定角色的相接前生成使用3+1程序:三个工人模式独立地完成了每个任务,而GLM-5.2整合了它们的输出.
在两条管线中,先被接通的意见被传递给交互接通. GLM-5.2在每一步骤都产生一个响应,最多有5个审查回合. 由此得出了每条输油管110个最后的同位素结论。

blocks.en: 3.6 Single-Model Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.6 单一模式评价

blocks.en: The 190-case held-out cohort was generated separately with eight candidate models: DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Gemma-4-31B, GLM-5.2, GPT-5.6-Sol, GPT-OSS-120B, Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3-235B, and Qwen3-Next-80B. Within each model-specific configuration, the same candidate model performed role assignment, generated every role-specific opinion, and conducted every review, revision, and finalization call. The role assignment for a case was reused by its free-form and structured pipelines.
blocks.zh: 190个案件被搁置组别分别产生8个候选模式: Depseek-V4-Pro,Gemma-4-31B,GLM-5.2,GPT-5.6-Sol,GPT-OSS-120B,Quen3.5-27B,Quen3-235B,和Quen3-Next-80B. 在每个模式具体组合中,同一个候选人模式执行角色分配,产生每个具体角色的意见,并进行每次审查、修订和最后敲定。 案件的作用分配被其自由形式和结构化管道所再利用。

blocks.en: All models received the same ordered held-out case set and the same stage- and response-format-specific prompts and schemas. Generation used temperature 0, top- p p 1, seed 42, and at most five review rounds. Model-specific maximum output allowances were retained: 1,024, 2,048, or 4,096 tokens for role assignment, 16,000 or 16,384 tokens for pre-consilium generation and 16,000 or 32,768 tokens for the interactive consilium. Endpoint routing and additional decoding controls were also fixed per model and recorded in the run manifests.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都收到同一套订购的被搁置案例以及同一套阶段和响应格式专用提示和计划。 世代使用温度0,最高-p 1,种子42,最多5个审查回合. 保留了特定模型的最大产出允许量:1 024个、2 048个或4 096个角色分配令牌、16 000个或16 384个预生令牌和16 000个或32 768个互动令牌。 每个型号也固定了终点路由和额外的解码控制,并记录在跑道清单中.

blocks.en: The descriptive process and Judge-scored analyses used these eight configurations. Role-level Judge scoring was performed only for the primary role in the structured pipeline, whereas final consilium conclusions were scored in both the free-form and structured pipelines; role-level Judge scores were not produced for free-form outputs.
blocks.zh: 描述过程和法官评分分析采用了这八种组合。 作用级法官评分只表现在结构化管道中的主要作用,而最终的连带结论则表现在自由形式和结构化管道中;作用级法官评分则不表现在自由形式产出上。

blocks.en: 3.7 Evaluation Criteria
blocks.zh: 3.7 评价标准

blocks.en: We used a physician-developed measurement framework comprising eight response-quality criteria and three separately interpreted panel- or case-level ratings (Table 1 ). The framework was informed by literature on multidisciplinary clinical review ( Lamb et al., 2011 ; Basta et al., 2017 ; Kočo et al., 2021 ; Soukup et al., 2020 ) , clinical LLM assessment ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Kocaman et al., 2025 ; McCoy and others, 2025 ; Brodeur and others, 2026 ) , uncertainty ( Savage and others, 2025 ) , and safety ( Asgari and others, 2025 ) . The eight response-quality criteria covered factual grounding, problem prioritization, data use, reasoning coherence, differential diagnosis, the final clinical conclusion, management, and safety. Their applicability was determined by the component being assessed.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了由医生开发的计量框架,其中包括8个反应质量标准和3个单独解释的小组或案例评级(表1)。 该框架参考了关于多学科临床审查的文献(Lamb等,2011年;Basta等,2017年;Kočo等,2021年;Soukup等,2020年),临床LLM评估(Tang等,2024年;Kocaman等,2025年;McCoy等,2025年), 2025;Brodeur等,2026),不确定性. (Savage等,2025年),与安全(Asgari等,2025年). 8项反应质量标准涉及事实依据、问题优先排序、数据使用、推理一致性、差异诊断、最终临床结论、管理和安全。 其适用性由正在评估的部分决定。

blocks.en: The eight response-quality criteria used a 0–3 ordinal scale: 0 - indicated that the criterion was not met, 1 - a major deficiency, 2 - a mostly adequate response with a noticeable limitation and 3 - full and clinically convincing satisfaction. Panel adequacy used the same numeric range but evaluated expertise coverage rather than response quality. Case complexity used 0, 1, 2, and 3 to denote low, moderate, high, and very high complexity. Overall quality was a physician-reported global assessment of all consilium stages.
blocks.zh: 八个响应质量标准采用0至3正数尺度: 0 - 表示没有达到标准,1 -- -- 主要缺陷,2 -- -- 反应大多充分,明显有局限性,3 -- -- 在临床上完全和令人信服。 小组的适足性使用相同的数值范围,但评价了专门知识的涵盖范围而不是反应质量。 案件复杂程度用0、1、2和3表示低、中、高和非常高的复杂性。 总体质量是医生报告的全球对所有同位素阶段的评估。

blocks.en: To account for characteristic LLM errors, an additional rule was introduced. If the final output contained a fabricated clinically significant fact - such as an examination result, numerical value, date, diagnosis, complication, or treatment recommendation absent from the source documents and not designated as a hypothesis - the “Factual accuracy and sources” criterion was assigned 0 points. If such a fact served as the basis for differential diagnosis, the final conclusion, or management strategy, the corresponding criteria were scored no higher than 1. This rule ensured that critical factual errors could not be offset by apparent logical coherence, structural completeness, or formatting quality.
blocks.zh: 为了说明LLM的特征错误,又引入了一条规则. 如果最后产出包含一个在临床上具有重大意义的捏造事实,如检查结果、数字值、日期、诊断、复杂情况或治疗建议,而来源文件没有将其指定为假设,则“事实准确性和来源”标准被定为0分。 如果这一事实成为作出差别诊断、最后结论或管理战略的依据,相应的标准得分不超过1分。 这一规则确保关键的事实错误不能被明显的逻辑一致性、结构完整性或格式化质量所抵消。

blocks.en: Table 1: Prespecified evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 表1:预先规定的评价标准。

blocks.en: 3.8 Physician Reference Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.8 医生参考评价

blocks.en: Physician ratings provided the reference for Judge calibration and internal evaluation. The evaluation panel comprised 6 physicians, each possessing cross-disciplinary expertise in multiple adjacent medical specialties. This configuration ensured comprehensive coverage of specialty-specific evaluation perspectives, composition of the multidisciplinary panels across the dataset. Each clinical case was evaluated from the standpoint of three specialties represented in the original consensus. Experts were exclusively assigned cases aligning with their clinical domain.
blocks.zh: 医生的评级为法官的校准和内部评价提供了参考。 评价小组由6名医生组成,每个医生都具有多个相邻医学专业的跨学科专长。 这一配置确保了对专门评价观点的全面覆盖,以及跨数据集多学科小组的组成。 每个临床病例都从最初共识所代表的三个专业的角度来评价. 专为专家分配了符合其临床领域的病例。

blocks.en: Evaluation was conducted under single-blind conditions: model outputs were randomly ordered and presented without model identifiers, generation condition labels, or paired responses from the alternative condition. Case presentations were delivered without source attribution or retrieval metadata, strictly adhering to the input protocol used for model inference.
blocks.zh: 评价是在单盲条件下进行的:模型输出是随机订购并呈现的,没有模型识别符,生成条件标签,或者替代条件的对接反应. 案例介绍没有来源归属或检索元数据,严格遵守用于模型推断的输入协议。

blocks.en: Raters used the fixed 0–3 rubric in Table 1 . Eight criteria were applied separately to clinical reasoning, the role-specific clinical opinion, and the final consilium report (24 fields). Three further fields covered panel adequacy, case complexity, and overall quality. Raters also entered a case comment and could use non-evaluable only where the rubric allowed.
blocks.zh: Raters在表1中使用了固定的0-3分. 8个标准分别应用于临床推理,角色特定临床意见,以及最终的同位素报告(24个领域). 另有三个领域涉及面板充足性、案件复杂性和总体质量。 Raters还输入了案例评语,只有在标题允许的情况下才能使用不可评价.

blocks.en: 3.9 Automated LLM Judge
blocks.zh: 3.9 自动化LLM 法官

blocks.en: We used GPT-OSS-120B as a physician-calibrated automated Judge ( OpenAI, 2025 ) . Prompts combined a fixed protocol, the criterion definition and four score anchors, an applicability rule, and an optional criterion-specific instruction. The case and candidate response were delimited from the instructions to reduce prompt injection. During calibration, only the optional instructions for criteria 1–9 varied. Each call received the case and one complete target component, but no other role outputs or later reports. The reference diagnosis was visible only for criterion 6 and could not support patient facts absent from the presentation. Criterion 11 remained physician reported and was not scored by the Judge.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-OSS-120B作为医生校准的自动化裁判(OpenAI,2025年). 提示结合了固定协议,标准定义和四个分数锚,适用性规则,以及可选标准特定指令. 案件和候选人答复从减少迅速注射的指示中划出。 在校正期间,只有标准1至9的可选说明不同。 每次通话都收到案件和一个完整的目标部分,但没有其他角色产出或以后的报告。 参考诊断只针对标准6可见,不能证明陈述中没有病人的事实。 标准11仍然是医生报告,法官没有打分。

blocks.en: Each applicable call returned a rationale and either a 0–3 score, not evaluable , or model failure ; infrastructure failures were never converted to zero. Calls used an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with temperature 0, top- p p 1, and an 8,000-token output limit.
blocks.zh: 每个适用的呼叫都回了理由,要么是0比3分,不能评价,要么是模型故障;基础设施故障从未转换为零。 呼叫使用了与温度0相容的OpenAI端点,顶端-p 1,并有8000个托肯输出限制.

blocks.en: The reasoning component was assessed on criteria 1–5, 7, and 8; the role-specific clinical opinion on criteria 1, 2, 4, 6, and 8; and the final consilium report on criteria 1–8. Criteria 9 and 10 were analyzed separately. We reported unweighted means and numeric coverage within each component. Structural exclusions and not evaluable outcomes were not scored, and means based on different criterion sets were not compared as estimates of checkpoint improvement.
blocks.zh: 对推理部分进行了以下评估:标准1-5、7和8;具体角色临床对标准1、2、4、6和8的意见;以及标准1-8的最后总结报告。 分别分析了标准9和10。 我们报告说,每个组成部分都有未加权的手段和数字覆盖范围。 结构性排除和不具有可评价结果没有得分,没有将基于不同标准组的办法与检查站改进的估计相比较。

blocks.en: 3.10 Exploratory Analysis of Completion Rounds and Judge Scores
blocks.zh: 3.10 对完成回合和法官分数的探索分析

blocks.en: We performed a descriptive analysis of whether final-answer Judge scores varied with the number of completed consilium review rounds. The analysis included 3,040 outputs from 190 cases, eight models, and two response formats. Because rounds 4 and 5 were uncommon, outputs were grouped as one, two, or at least three completed rounds. For each group, we report the mean and population standard deviation (SD) of the output-level mean across numeric scores for criteria 1–8, the proportion of outputs with a mean below 2, and the criterion 10 case-complexity score. Criterion 10 was not included in the response-quality mean. The round count described review of the retained report, whereas the Judge assessed the subsequent final answer and did not receive the round count or stopping reason.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了描述性分析,分析最后答案法官的分数是否与已完成的康西来姆审查回合的数目不同。 分析包括190个案例的3 040个产出、8个模型和2个答复格式。 由于第四轮和第五轮不同寻常,产出分为一、二或至少三轮完成。 对于每一组,我们报告标准1-8产出水平平均分数的平均值和人口标准差(SD),平均分数低于2的产出比例,以及标准10的复杂案例分数。 标准10没有列入反应质量平均值。 圆计数说明了对所保留报告的审查,而法官评估了随后的最后答复,没有收到圆计数或停止理由。

blocks.en: 3.11 Calibration of Judge Guidance
blocks.zh: 3.11 法官指导的校正

blocks.en: We optimized one operational prompt, g k g_{k} , for each criterion k ∈ { 1 , … , 9 } k\in\{1,\ldots,9\} using GigaEvo and MAP-Elites ( Khrulkov et al., 2025 ; Mouret and Clune, 2015 ; Lehman et al., 2022 ; Lim et al., 2024 ) . The general Judge instructions and all criterion definitions, scales, applicability rules, schemas, and reference policies were fixed. Candidate prompts were limited to 800 characters and could not migrate across criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们利用GigaEvo和MAP-Elites(Khrulkov等,2025年;Mouret和Clune,2015年;Lehman等,2022年;Lim等,2024年),优化了每个标准k {{ 1,.,.,.,9}的操作提示。 一般法官指示和所有标准定义、尺度、适用性规则、计划以及参考政策均已确定。 候选人的提示限于800个字符,不能跨标准迁移。

blocks.en: The prespecified 110-case sampling frame was partitioned by DOI into 80 evolutionary-training cases and 30 internal-validation cases. All completed targets and ratings from one DOI remained in the same subset. Evolution used only eligible structured targets and physician ratings from the training subset. Ratings from the internal-validation subset were withheld from mutation and parent selection.

blocks.en: MAE expresses Judge–physician disagreement directly in scale points and is less sensitive to large errors than squared loss ( Gneiting, 2011 ; Willmott and Matsuura, 2005 ) . It is commonly used for ordinal prediction ( Baccianella et al., 2009 ) , but assumes meaningful distances between score categories and does not fully characterize agreement; we therefore treated it as an error summary, not a complete validity measure.
blocks.zh: 与平分损失相比,MAE表达的是Judge — — 物理学家在比分点上的分歧,对大错误的敏感度较低(Gneiting, 2011;Willmott and Matsuura, 2005). 它通常用于正数预测(Baccianella等,2009年),但假定在分数类别之间有有意义的距离,并不完全定性为一致;因此,我们把它视为一个错误摘要,而不是一个完整的有效性计量.

blocks.en: The search used nine isolated criterion archives (capacity 540), initialized with two candidates per criterion. GPT-OSS-120B generated mutations at temperature 0.3 with a 4,096-token limit. We retained 225 mutants (25 per criterion) from at most 320 attempts. For each criterion, the lowest-MAE prompt was selected, with ties resolved by repeat stability, length, and program identifier. Selected prompts were re-evaluated on training and internal-validation cases with fresh seeds and compared with no-guidance, initial-prompt, and training-median baselines before semantic review.
blocks.zh: 搜查使用了9个孤立的标准档案(容量540个),每个标准有两个候选人。 GPT-OSS-120B在0.3温度下产生有4,096个托肯极限的突变. 我们从最多320次尝试中保留了225名变种人(每个标准25人)。 对于每个标准,选择了最低的-MAE快取,通过重复稳定,长度,以及程序标识符解决了链接. 在语义审查之前,重新评价了有新种子的培训和内部验证案例,并与无指导、初步即时和培训中间基线进行比较。

blocks.en: Judge calibration was summarized by criterion-specific MAE against individual physician ratings, repeat-to-repeat SD, numeric coverage, and signed error where reported. The held-out clinical-quality analyses were descriptive. We retained the original 0–3 criterion scores and reported numeric means, population SDs, outcome distributions, and numeric coverage. No weighted composite, 0–100 transformation, readiness threshold, or single confirmatory primary quality outcome was used. Because evaluation components had different structurally applicable criterion sets, their pooled means were not treated as directly exchangeable estimates of checkpoint improvement.
blocks.zh: 法官的校准是根据特定标准对个别医生的评分、重复到重复的SD、数字覆盖和在报告时签名的错误来总结的。 搁置的临床质量分析是描述性的。 我们保留了最初的0–3标准分数和所报告的数字手段、人口自毁、结果分布和数字覆盖。 没有使用加权复合材料、0-100转换、准备状态阈值或单一确认初级质量结果。 由于评价组成部分有不同的结构适用标准,其集合手段不被视为检查站改进的直接可交换估计数。

blocks.en: Response-format and model summaries used the fixed model roster described above. Numeric means excluded structurally inapplicable fields and response-dependent not evaluable outcomes; both were reported separately and neither was assigned zero. Model failures were likewise retained as failures rather than converted to clinical scores. The process analyses used DOI-clustered bootstrap intervals as specified above. Held-out Judge-score tables were used for descriptive comparison rather than confirmatory model ranking or multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis testing.
blocks.zh: 答复格式和模型摘要采用了上述固定模型名册。 数字是指排除结构上不适用的领域和依赖反应而不能评价的结果;两者都是单独报告的,两者都不划为零。 模型故障也作为故障保留,而不是转换成临床分数。 流程分析采用上文所述的DOI集群的靴子间隔。 被搁置的法官评分表用于描述性比较,而不是用于确认模型排名或多重调整假说测试。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Cases Composition
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价案件

blocks.en: Table 2: Characteristics of the physician-annotation/Judge-calibration and held-out evaluation cohorts.
blocks.zh: 表2:医生说明/法官校准和搁置评价组别的特点。

blocks.en: All models completed both response-format pipelines for all 190 held-out cases (100% coverage). The 1,520 unique case–model panels contained 7,271 role slots (mean, 4.78 per panel); reuse of each panel across the free-form and structured conditions yielded 14,542 role-specific opinions and 3,040 final consilium opinions. These artifact counts describe coverage, whereas the DOI remains the inferential unit.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都完成了所有190起搁置案件(100%覆盖)的两种反应形式管道。 1,520个独特的案例模型板包含7,271个角色槽(平均,每块4.78个);在自由形式和结构化条件下对每个面板的再利用产生了14,542个角色特有意见和3,040个最后的集合意见。 这些文物统计说明覆盖范围,而内政部仍然是推断单位。

blocks.en: Panel selection was strongly concentrated at the configured ceiling. Among 1,520 case–model panels, 8 (0.5%) contained two roles, 53 (3.5%) contained three, 199 (13.1%) contained four, and 1,260 (82.9%) contained five (Figure 2 b). 7 models had a median of five roles, Gemma-4-31B had a median of four. Because the selector could assign at most five roles, this concentration shows that most configurations frequently exhausted the panel capacity, not that five was an empirically optimal panel size, it also provided little empirical variation for assessing whether panel cardinality adapted to the case.
blocks.zh: 小组的甄选工作主要集中于规定的上限。 在1 520个案件模型中,8个(0.5%)包含两个角色,53个(3.5%)包含三个,199个(13.1%)包含四个,1 260个(82.9%)包含五个(图2b)。 7个型号的中位数为5个角色,Gemma-4-31B的中位数为4个. 由于选择者最多可以指派五个角色,这种集中表明,大多数配置经常会耗尽面板能力,而不是五个是经验上最优的面板规模,因此,在评估面板是否适合案件的基本性方面也几乎没有经验上的差异。

blocks.en: The 7,271 assignments used 696 exact model-generated role labels, including 212 exact labels among the 1,520 primary designations. This lexical variety largely reflected differences in naming granularity rather than hundreds of clinically distinct disciplines. After mutually exclusive harmonization, infectious disease, radiology, and neurology were the most frequent categories, whereas neurology (245/1,520, 16.1%) and infectious disease (199/1,520, 13.1%) were the most frequent primary roles (Figure 2 c). Radiology-containing labels appeared in 729 assignments but received only 3 primary designations (0.4% of radiology assignments), indicating that the selector usually prioritized another discipline as the principal case perspective.
blocks.zh: 7,271个任务使用了696个精确的模型生成的角色标签,包括1,520个主名中212个精确的标签. 这种词汇种类主要反映了颗粒性命名的不同,而不是数百个临床上截然不同的学科. 在相互排斥的协调之后,传染病、放射学和神经学是最常见的类别,而神经学(245/1,520,16.1%)和传染病(199/1,520,13.1%)是最常见的主要角色(图2c)。 含放射科的标签出现在729个任务中,但只得到了3个主要指定(占放射科任务的0.4%),表明选取者通常将另一学科作为主要案例视角优先.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Held-out cohort flow and model-generated panel architecture. (a) Only the 190 held-out cases entered the eight-model evaluation. Shared role assignments fed separate free-form and structured outputs; counts denote cases and artifacts, not enrolled participants. (b) Cell values are percentages within each model; the pooled row summarizes all 1,520 panels. (c) Categories are ranked by all 7,271 assignments and use separate primary and supporting denominators. The complete exact-label mapping is retained with the generated artifacts.
blocks.zh: 图 2:被搁置组群流和模型生成的面板架构. (a) 只有190起搁置案件进入了八模式评价。 分担角色的任务提供了单独的免费和结构化产出;计数是指个案和文物,而不是登记的参与者。 (b) 单元格值是每个模型中的百分比;集合行汇总所有1 520个面板。 (c) 类别按所有7 271项任务排列,并使用单独的初级和辅助分母。 完整的精确标签绘图与生成的文物一起保留.

blocks.en: 4.2 Consilium Dynamics
blocks.zh: 4.2 相位动力学

blocks.en: Across models and response formats, the interactive review showed a clear pattern of early convergence. Report consensus-defined as unanimous role acceptance of the reviewed shared report before finalization-was achieved at the first review in 1,204 of 3,040 case–model–format instances (39.6%). By the end of round 2, 2,576 instances (84.7%) had reached consensus, and 2,974 (97.8%) ultimately did so (Figures 3 a and 4 ). Importantly, convergence was not confined to reports accepted at the outset: among the 1,836 initially disputed instances, 1,770 (96.4%) subsequently reached unanimous acceptance. Overall, the review loop converted most contested initial reports into accepted shared reports, with agreement typically emerging within the first two rounds.
blocks.zh: 互动审查在模型和反应格式方面都显示出一种明显的早期趋同模式。 在第一次审查中,在3,040个案例的模型格式实例(39.6%)中,有1,204个案例在最终定稿前一致接受经审查的共同报告。 到第2轮结束时,2 576例(84.7%)已达成共识,2 974例(97.8%)最终达成共识(图3a和4)。 重要的是,趋同不仅限于最初接受的报告:在最初有争议的1 836起案例中,1 770起(96.4%)后来获得一致接受。 总的来说,审查循环将大多数有争议的初次报告转化为接受的共享报告,通常在前两轮内形成一致意见。

blocks.en: The process pattern varied substantially among models. GPT-5.6-Sol accepted most reports at the first review and required the fewest rounds, whereas Qwen3.5-27B began with dissent from every role but still reached eventual consensus in almost every case. These contrasting trajectories show that the benchmark captures model-specific review behavior in addition to final-answer quality.
blocks.zh: 各个模型的过程模式差异很大。 GPT-5.6-Sol在第一次审查时接受了大多数报告,并要求进行最少量的回合,而Quen3.5-27B则以对每个角色的异议为开端,但在几乎每个案例中仍然最终达成共识. 这些对比性的轨迹表明,基准除了最终答案的质量外,还捕捉了模型特有的审查行为.

blocks.en: Structured reports generally prompted somewhat more review. Structured and free-form pipelines averaged 1.89 and 1.76 rounds, respectively, and reached consensus in 97.3% and 98.4% of instances. The structured and free-form pipelines reached the five-round limit in 1.6% and 1.1% of cases. This aggregate pattern was model dependent (Table 3 ): DeepSeek-V4-Pro, for example, required fewer rounds for structured than for free-form reports (1.27 vs. 1.77).
blocks.zh: 结构化报告通常引起更多的审查。 结构化和自由式管道分别平均为1.89轮和1.76轮,并在97.3%和98.4%的情况下达成共识。 在1.6%和1.1%。 这种总体模式取决于模型(表3):例如,DeepSeek-V4-Pro的结构报告所需的轮数比自由格式报告所需的轮数要少(1.27对1.77)。

blocks.en: Consensus did not mark the end of generation because a separate finalizer produced the delivered clinical answer after review. A complete path averaged 106.9 thousand provider-reported tokens per free-form case and 133.3 thousand per structured case; the structured pipeline therefore used 26.5 thousand additional tokens. The protocol consequently produced consistent procedural convergence, while structured reporting increased inference requirements. These process outcomes characterize role-conditioned synthetic review behavior and complement, rather than replace, direct assessment of clinical quality.
blocks.zh: 共识并没有标志着一代人的结束,因为一个单独的定稿者在审查后提出了临床答案。 一条完整的路径平均为每件免费表格的10.69万个供应商报告信使,每件结构化文件133.3万个;因此,结构化管道使用了26.5万个额外的信使。 因此,议定书在程序上产生了一致的趋同,而结构化的报告则增加了推论要求。 这些过程结果定性为角色有条件的合成审查行为,是对临床质量直接评估的补充而不是取而代之.

(a) Cumulative percentage of 1,520 arms per response format with unanimous acceptance of the reviewed report; round 1 evaluates the initial report. Counts show arms entering each round. (b) Mean reduction in dissent among the same arms before and after each revision, with 95% CIs from 10,000 DOI-clustered bootstrap resamples; the right column gives the number of arms compared. (c) Free-form (blue circles) and structured (orange squares) outcomes by model; lines connect response formats within models, and the final row pools the fixed eight-model set.

Each continuous 100% stacked bar partitions 1,520 interactive consilia into mutually exclusive stop reasons; labels give counts and percentages.
