blocks.en: 4.3 Physician Ratings and Judge Calibration
blocks.zh: 4.3 医生评级和法官校正

blocks.en: Six physicians supplied criterion-level reference ratings for Judge-guidance development and internal validation within the fixed 110-case sampling frame. DOI-disjoint development subsets and independent optimization of each criterion preserved case separation and prevented a favorable result for one clinical dimension from compensating for another. This design produced a Judge that could characterize factual grounding, reasoning, management, safety, and conclusion quality separately rather than collapsing them into one undifferentiated score.
blocks.zh: 6名医生在固定的110个案例抽样框架内为法官指导的制定和内部验证提供了标准级别的参考评级。 DOI-脱节开发子集和每个标准的独立优化保留了病例分离,使一个临床方面的有利结果无法补偿另一个。 这一设计产生了一名法官,该法官可以将事实基础、推理、管理、安全和结论质量分别定性,而不是将它们分解成一个无差别的分数。

blocks.en: Criterion-local optimization reduced macro-mean validation MAE from 0.8601 without additional guidance and 0.9033 with the initial prompts to 0.7798 with the selected guidance, a 9.3% improvement over the no-additional-guidance configuration. The clearest validation gains occurred for factual grounding, differential diagnosis, and management.
blocks.zh: Criterion-local explained MAE在没有附加指导的情况下,将宏平均值验证从0.8601和0.9033减少为0.7798,与不附加指导配置相比,初步提示为0.9798。 最明确的验证成果是事实依据、差别诊断和管理。

blocks.en: The held-out benchmark used one fixed Judge configuration across all candidate outputs. Calibration performance remained criterion specific, as intended by the evaluation design. Criterion 6, which jointly assesses conclusion clarity, diagnostic concordance, evidence grounding, and uncertainty, was the most demanding target (MAE, 1.6667). We therefore use the Judge to identify consistent criterion-level and model-level patterns, while interpreting small differences in this composite criterion conservatively.
blocks.zh: 搁置基准在所有候选人产出中使用了一个固定的法官配置。 校准业绩仍然是具体标准,这是评价设计的目的。 标准6共同评估了结论的清晰度、诊断一致性、证据依据和不确定性,是要求最高的目标(货币法,1.667)。 因此,我们利用法官确定一致的标准级别和模式级别模式,同时保守地解释这一综合标准中的小差异。

blocks.en: The evolutionary search improved or preserved training re-evaluation MAE for every criterion and transferred its gains to disjoint validation cases for factual grounding, data use, differential diagnosis, and management (Table 5 ). The largest validation reductions were observed for factual grounding (1.2222 to 0.6296) and management (0.8889 to 0.5000). These results show that criterion-local guidance can produce substantial numerical agreement gains for clinically interpretable dimensions even when a single universal prompt would obscure them.
blocks.zh: 进化搜索改进或保留了对每项标准的培训评估,并将其成果转移到了对事实依据、数据使用、差异诊断和管理的脱节验证案例(表5)。 实际论证减少最多(1.222至0.6296)和管理(0.8889至0.5000)。 这些结果表明,标准-局部指导可产生临床可解释维度的重大数值协议增益,即使单一的普速会掩盖这些维度。

blocks.en: Table 5: Criterion-specific MAE of the best initial candidates and evolved descendants in the criterion-local calibration run.
blocks.zh: 表5:特定标准 最佳初始候选人的MAE和在标准-局部校正跑中演化出后人.

blocks.en: 4.4 Held-Out Benchmark Performance
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 基准执行情况

blocks.en: All eight model pipelines were evaluated on the same 190 held-out cases in both response formats, with complete generation coverage and no final Judge failures. The analysis included 6,080 response components and 54,720 recorded criterion outcomes. By evaluating the same cases at the role-opinion and final-synthesis checkpoints, the benchmark allowed model capability, response format, and the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis to be examined separately on the original 0–3 criterion scale (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 所有8个示范管道都以两种反应形式对相同的190个搁置案件进行了评价,涵盖整个生成范围,没有最终法官失误。 分析包括6 080个答复部分和54 720个记录的标准结果。 通过在作用-观点和最后综合检查站评价同样的情况,基准允许在最初的0至3标准尺度(表6)上分别审查模型能力、反应格式和多学科综合的贡献。

blocks.en: Table 6: Descriptive Judge-score summaries across the three evaluation components in the eight-model evaluation on 190 cases per model.
blocks.zh: 表6:关于每个模式190个案件的八模式评价中三个评价组成部分的法官评分摘要说明。

blocks.en: Across this fixed benchmark, model identity produced the largest descriptive separation in overall performance. GPT-5.6-Sol ranked first in structured role reasoning, role clinical opinion, free-form conclusions, and structured conclusions; Qwen3-Next-80B ranked last in all four components. GPT-5.6-Sol exceeded the next-highest model by 0.430 points for role reasoning, 0.404 for role clinical opinion, 0.165 for free-form conclusions, and 0.203 for structured conclusions. The best-to-worst model spread in final reports was 0.463 points for free-form and 0.572 for structured outputs, substantially larger than every within-model format difference ( − 0.045 -0.045 to + 0.064 +0.064 ). The model ordering of final reports was identical in the two response formats, showing that the benchmark recovered a stable model hierarchy and that model choice was more strongly associated with final-report quality than the global response schema.
blocks.zh: 在整个固定基准中,模型特性产生了总体业绩中最大的描述性分离。 GPT-5.6-Sol在结构化角色推理,角色临床意见,自由形式结论,结构化结论中排名第一;Quen3-Next-80B在所有四个组成部分中排名最后. GPT-5.6-Sol以0.430分的角色推理,0.404分的角色临床意见,0.165分的自由形式结论,0.203分的结构结论,超越了次高模型. 在最后报告中传播的最坏模式是自由形式的0.463分,结构化产出0.572分,大大大于模式内格式的每个差异(-0.045-0.045至+0.064+0.064),两种答复格式对最后报告进行模式排序相同,表明基准恢复了稳定的模式等级结构,模式选择与最后报告质量的关系比全球反应方案更为密切。

blocks.en: Structured conclusions had higher overall means than their free-form counterparts in seven of the eight model pipelines. GPT-5.6-Sol showed the largest structured-minus-free-form difference ( + 0.064 +0.064 points), followed by Gemma-4-31B ( + 0.038 +0.038 ); Qwen3-Next-80B was the only pipeline with a lower structured mean ( − 0.045 -0.045 ). Thus, the model-level comparison showed a broad, although modest, advantage for structured final reporting.
blocks.zh: 结构化结论的总体手段高于8个示范管道中7个的免费对应手段。 GPT-5.6-Sol显示了最大的结构-减-无结构相差(+0.064+0.064分),其次是Gemma-4-31B(+0.038+0.038分);Qune3-Next-80B是唯一结构相差较小的管道相差(-0.045-0.045分). 因此,模型层面的比较表明,结构化最后报告具有广泛但又不大的优势。

blocks.en: To contextualize these quality differences, Table 7 presents final-report Judge scores alongside complete-pipeline token use for each model and response format on the same 190 held-out cases. For GPT-5.6-Sol, the mean score increased from 2.708 with free-form reporting to 2.772 with structured reporting, while mean token use increased from 65.2 thousand to 132.1 thousand per case. These comparisons describe the inference requirements accompanying the observed quality differences.
blocks.zh: 为使这些质量差异的背景化,表7列出最终报告法官的分数,同时列出190起搁置案件的每个模型和答复格式的全管符号使用。 就GPT-5.6-Sol而言,平均得分从自由式报告的2.708增加到结构式报告的2.772,而平均象征性使用从每例65.2万增加到132.1万。 这些比较说明了所观察到的质量差异的推论要求。

blocks.en: Table 7: Judge-rated quality and observed inference requirements by model and response format.
blocks.zh: 表7:按模型和反应格式分列的评分质量和遵守的推断要求。

blocks.en: The complete multidisciplinary synthesis had higher pooled Judge means for every criterion shared with the isolated primary-role components (Table 8 ). Relative to structured role reasoning, the structured final report was higher by 0.650 points in factual grounding, 0.302 in reasoning coherence, 0.225 in safety, and 0.210 in problem prioritization; data use, differential diagnosis, and management were also higher. Relative to the role-specific clinical opinion, the final report was higher by 0.515 points in problem prioritization, 0.377 in factual grounding, 0.357 in reasoning coherence, 0.111 in clinical-conclusion quality, and 0.104 in safety. The largest gains therefore concerned integration of case facts, prioritization of the clinical problem, and construction of a coherent account. These findings identify a clear value of the complete synthesis stage: it transformed isolated role-specific material into a more highly rated, integrated clinical second opinion across every comparable dimension.
blocks.zh: 完整的多学科综合分析对与孤立的主要作用部分共享的每一项标准具有较高的集合法官手段(表8)。 与结构化角色推理相比,结构化最后报告在事实依据方面高出了0.650分,在推理一致性方面高出了0.302分,在安全方面高出了0.225分,在问题优先排序方面高出了0.210分;数据使用、差异诊断和管理程度也较高。 相对于角色特定临床意见,最终报告在问题优先排序上较高了0.515分,在事实定位上高了0.377分,在推理一致性上高了0.357分,在临床结论质量上高了0.11分,在安全性上高了0.104分. 因此,最大的收益涉及案例事实的整合、临床问题的优先次序以及构建一个连贯的账户。 这些发现明确了完整合成阶段的价值:它将孤立的角色特有材料转化为一个更高分,综合的临床第二意见,涵盖每个可比较的维度.

blocks.en: Structured prompting had its clearest descriptive advantage in actionability. Management was higher by 0.304 points (2.740 vs. 2.436), with the same direction in seven of eight model pipelines; problem prioritization was higher by 0.056 and factual grounding by 0.040. The overall final-report mean was likewise higher in seven of eight models. The criterion-level advantage was concentrated rather than uniform: reasoning coherence was essentially unchanged, while data use, differential diagnosis, clinical-conclusion quality, and safety were modestly lower. The broad model-level advantage of structured reports was therefore driven primarily by the comparatively large management gain, which outweighed smaller decreases in several other criteria. Structured prompting improved the actionability and organization of the second opinion rather than every aspect of its clinical profile.
blocks.zh: 结构化催化在可操作性方面具有最明确的描述优势。 管理高点为0.304分(2.740分对2.436分),在8个管线模式中的7个模式方向相同;问题优先排序高点为0.056分,实际落地为0.040分. 在8个模式中的7个模式中,总体最后报告平均值也较高。 标准层次优势集中而非统一:推理一致性基本不变,而数据使用,差分诊断,临床结论质量,安全性略低. 因此,结构化报告具有广泛的模式层面优势,这主要是由于管理收益相对较大,超过其他几项标准较小的减少。 结构化促使第二意见的可操作性和组织性得到改善,而不是其临床概况的每个方面。

blocks.en: Table 8: Criterion-specific profiles pooled across the eight models.
blocks.zh: 表8:八种模式的具体标准简介。

blocks.en: 4.5 Distribution of Judge Scores Across Cases and Criteria
blocks.zh: 4.5 法官分数在案件和标准中的分布情况

blocks.en: The criterion distributions revealed a clear aggregate pattern across the 3,040 final reports. Problem prioritization, reasoning coherence, and differential diagnosis were concentrated at the top of the scale, whereas final-conclusion quality and safety accounted for most of the clinically important residual variation (Figures 6 and 7 ). Each case contributed once to the case-level distributions after averaging the available scores across the 16 model–format combinations.
blocks.zh: 标准分布情况表明,3 040份最后报告的汇总情况明显。 问题优先次序、推理一致性和差异性诊断集中在尺度的顶端,而最终结论的质量和安全是临床上重要的剩余变异(图6和图7)。 每个案例在平均16个模型-格式组合的现有分数之后,都对案例一级的分布作出了一次贡献。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Distribution of Judge outcomes for multidisciplinary conclusions by criterion. Each horizontal bar represents all 3,040 model-format opportunities for one criterion; the score categories and not-evaluable outcomes therefore sum to 100%.
blocks.zh: 图6:按标准分列的法官多学科结论结果分布情况。 每个水平栏代表一个标准的所有3 040个模式格式机会;因此,得分类别和不可评价的结果等于100%。

blocks.en: The criterion-level results were strongest for problem prioritization, reasoning coherence, and differential diagnosis: 81.5% received the maximum score for problem prioritization, 90.4% for reasoning coherence, and 80.9% for differential diagnosis. Under the frozen Judge, the principal measured weakness appeared when this strong reasoning had to be converted into a definitive, evidence-calibrated clinical conclusion. Among numeric criterion 6 scores, 62.8% were 0 or 1. Safety was the second least-saturated dimension: 48.8% of reports received the maximum score, leaving substantial room to strengthen monitoring, contraindication handling, and escalation guidance. The benchmark therefore distinguishes fluent diagnostic reasoning from the harder task of producing a highly rated, calibrated, and safe final decision.
blocks.zh: 标准层面的结果对于确定问题优先次序、推理一致性和差别诊断最为强烈:81.5%获得问题优先次序最高分,90.4%获得推理一致性,80.9%获得差别诊断。 在被冻结的法官之下,主要衡量的弱点出现,因为这一强有力的推理必须转化为一个确定、证据校正的临床结论。 在数值标准6分中,62.8%为0分或1. 安全是第二个最不饱和的方面:48.8%的报告得到最高分,为加强监测、禁忌处理和升级指导留下了很大的空间。 因此,该基准将流利的诊断推理与作出高度评级、校正和安全的最终决定这一更艰巨的任务区分开来。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Distribution of case-level mean Judge scores for multidisciplinary conclusions. For each case and criterion, the mean was calculated over numeric scores from eight models and two response formats. Bars count cases in 0.5-point bins; vertical red lines show the median. Not-evaluable outcomes were excluded from the means.
blocks.zh: 图7:多学科结论中法官的平均分数分布情况。 对于每个案例和标准,平均数都是从8个模型和2个响应格式计算出来的。 条以0.5分的收件箱来计算病例;垂直的红线显示中位数. 无法评价的结果被排除在手段之外。

blocks.en: Case-level distributions reinforced this separation. Problem prioritization, reasoning coherence, and differential diagnosis each had a median of 2.812, with narrow interquartile ranges near the top of the scale. Clinical-conclusion quality had a markedly lower median of 1.215 (IQR, 0.667–2.000) and the widest between-case spread. Factual grounding (median, 2.375) and safety (median, 2.188) occupied intermediate positions. These profiles identify conclusion formation, rather than generation of a plausible differential, as the main target for further improvement.
blocks.zh: 个案一级的分布加强了这种分离。 问题优先排序、推理一致性和差别诊断的中位数分别为2.812,范围狭窄,接近比例表上方。 临床结业质量的中位数明显较低,为1.215 (IQR, 0.667-2.00),在病例之间分布最广。 事实地面(中间点,2.375)和安全(中间点, 2.188)占据中间位置。 这些概况将结论形成,而不是产生可能的差异,作为进一步改进的主要目标。

blocks.en: 4.6 Judge Scores and Consilium Completion Rounds
blocks.zh: 4.6 法官分数和康西里姆完成回合

blocks.en: Review duration varied strongly by model–format configuration and showed no monotonic relation with Judge-rated case complexity. Qwen3.5-27B produced no one-round reports in either format, and rounds 4–5 were concentrated in GPT-OSS-120B and Qwen3.5-27B (Table 3 ). Completed rounds therefore captured persistent role-conditioned disagreement more clearly than case difficulty.
blocks.zh: 审查期限因模式-格式配置而大相径庭,与法官评分的案件复杂性没有单一关系。 Quen3.5-27B没有以两种格式提出一回合报告,第4至5轮集中在GPT-OSS-120B和Quen3.5-27B(表3)。 因此,已完成的几轮谈判比案件难度更清楚地反映了持续存在的角色限制分歧。

blocks.en: GPT-5.6-Sol combined the highest Judge scores with the shortest review trajectories. It averaged 1.22 review rounds for free-form reports and 1.23 for structured reports, with first-round unanimous acceptance in 81.6% and 79.5% of cases and eventual report consensus in 100.0% and 98.9%, respectively. This combination identifies GPT-5.6-Sol as both the quality leader and the most rapidly converging pipeline in the evaluated cohort.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.6-Sol将评分最高的评分与最短的评分轨迹合并. 平均有1.22轮审查自由形式报告,1.23轮审查结构化报告,第一轮一致接受的个案分别为81.6%和79.5%,最终的报告共识分别为100.0%和98.9%。 这一组合将GPT-5.6-Sol确定为质量领先和被评价组群中最快速汇合的管道。

blocks.en: Table 9: Final-answer Judge scores and case complexity by completed review rounds.
blocks.zh: 表9:最后答复 法官评分和案件复杂性,按已完成的审查周期计算。

blocks.en: Longer review trajectories were not associated with higher Judge-rated quality. Mean final-report scores were 2.525 after one round, 2.419 after two rounds, and 2.438 after three or more rounds. The proportion of outputs with a mean score below 2 was also lowest after one round (5.1% vs. 8.9% and 7.3%). Mean Judge-rated case-complexity scores were nearly identical across these groups (2.148, 2.131, and 2.158). In these descriptive comparisons, outputs completed after additional review rounds showed no quality advantage. This pattern supports prospective evaluation of an early-stopping strategy but does not estimate the effect of terminating an ongoing review earlier (Table 9 ; Figure 8 ).
blocks.zh: 更长时间的审查轨迹与法官评分较高的质量无关。 平均最终报告分数为一回合后2.525分,两回合后2.419分,三轮或多回合后2.438分. 平均分低于2的产出比例在一轮之后也最低(5.1%对8.9%和7.3%)。 法官评分的复杂案件平均分数在这些组别中几乎相同(2.148、2.131和2.158)。 在这些描述性比较中,经过多轮审查后完成的产出没有质量优势。 这一模式支持对早期停止战略进行预期评价,但并未估计提前终止正在进行的审查的影响(表9;图8)。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Judge scores and case complexity by completed consilium review rounds. Panels show descriptive summaries for one, two, and at least three rounds. Error bars in panels A and C show population SD; panel B shows the proportion of outputs with a mean score below 2. The mean in panels A and B averages available numeric scores for criteria 1–8; criterion 10 was analyzed separately.
blocks.zh: 图8:法官评分和案件复杂程度,按已完成的复数周期分列。 小组对一、二和至少三轮作了描述性总结。 面板 A 和 C 的错误栏显示人口SD; B 面板显示输出比例,平均分数低于 2. 联合国 标准1-8的A和B小组的平均数值;标准10是分开分析的。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Principal Findings
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要调查结果

blocks.en: This study produced four principal findings. First, model identity separated final-report quality more strongly than response format: GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component, the model ordering was identical across final-report formats, and the best-to-worst spread substantially exceeded all within-model format differences. Second, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled Judge means than the pre-consilium primary-role opinion for every shared criterion, with the largest gains in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. Third, structured final reports achieved higher overall means in seven of eight model pipelines; this broad model-level advantage was driven primarily by a 0.304-point improvement in management, which was also observed in seven pipelines. Fourth, the review protocol reached eventual consensus in 97.8% of reports, whereas longer review trajectories had no final-report score advantage. GPT-5.6-Sol combined the highest report quality with the fewest review rounds, linking strong initial performance with rapid convergence in this protocol.
blocks.zh: 这项研究得出了四项主要结论。 首先,模型身份分离的最后报告质量比反应格式更强:GPT-5.6-Sol领导了每个被评价的组件,模型订购在最终报告格式上是相同的,最优到最坏的传播大大超过了模型格式内的所有差异. 第二,完整的结构化综合分析拥有比每个共同标准前的集合法官手段更高的集合法官手段,在问题优先排序、事实依据和推理一致性方面收益最大。 第三,结构化最后报告在八条管线中的七条实现了更高的总体手段;这种广泛的管线一级优势主要是管理改进了0.304分,这在七条管线中也观察到了这一点。 第四,审查议定书最终在97.8%的报告中达成共识,而较长的审查轨迹没有最终报告得分优势。 GPT-5.6-Sol将最高报告质量与最少数审查回合相结合,将强劲的初步表现与本议定书的迅速趋同联系起来.

blocks.en: The stage comparison showed a favorable aggregate pattern for the full synthesis pipeline. Its final reports had higher pooled Judge means for every criterion comparable with the structured primary-role output. The largest differences occurred in problem prioritization, grounding, and coherence, consistent with the consilium integrating case evidence and role-specific perspectives into a clearer and more clinically organized account. The result is important because it demonstrates value beyond generation of additional text: the final synthesis more effectively assembled the available material into a complete clinical second opinion. The comparison represents the contribution of the full synthesis pipeline, including aggregation, review, revision, and finalization, rather than an isolated causal effect of discussion alone.
blocks.zh: 阶段比较显示,整个合成管道的总量模式是有利的。 其最后报告对与结构化的主要作用产出相仿的每一项标准,都具有较高的集合法官手段。 最大的差异发生在问题的优先次序、基础和一致性方面,这符合将案件证据和具体角色的视角纳入更明确和更临床地组织起来的账户的概括。 这一结果很重要,因为它显示的价值超出了额外文本的生成范围:最终的合成更有效地将现有材料集成到一个完整的临床第二意见. 比较代表了包括汇总、审查、修订和最后审定在内的全面综合程序的贡献,而不是讨论的孤立的因果关系。

blocks.en: Structured prompting had its clearest advantage when the response required explicit action planning. Its management difference was the largest format-associated criterion contrast and had the same direction across seven of eight models. This comparatively large gain explains why structured reports had higher overall means in seven pipelines even though several smaller criterion differences favored free-form reports. Smaller advantages in prioritization and grounding further indicate that the implemented structured workflow produced a more organized and actionable plan. Structured prompting therefore added value through management quality and organization rather than through uniform improvement of every criterion.
blocks.zh: 在应对需要明确的行动规划时,结构化的催化具有最明显的优势。 其管理差异是最大的与格式相关的标准对比,在8个模型中的7个模型中方向相同。 这一相对较高的收益解释了为什么结构化报告在七个编审中的总体含义较高,尽管有几个较小的标准差异倾向于自由格式报告。 在确定优先次序和确定基准方面的较小优势进一步表明,已实施的结构化工作流程产生了一个更有条理和可操作性的计划。 因此,通过管理质量和组织,而不是通过统一改进每项标准,结构化地促进增值。

blocks.en: 5.2 Value of the Benchmark
blocks.zh: 5.2 基准值

blocks.en: The benchmark was designed to evaluate a clinical second opinion as a complete decision-support artifact rather than as a single diagnostic answer. Its eight response-quality criteria separately measure whether a model uses the supplied facts correctly, identifies and prioritizes the clinical problems, integrates relevant data, constructs coherent reasoning, develops an appropriate differential diagnosis, reaches a calibrated conclusion, proposes an actionable management plan, and addresses safety. This profile makes it possible to distinguish models that produce fluent diagnostic reasoning from those that can also convert that reasoning into a grounded, usable, and safe clinical recommendation.
blocks.zh: 该基准旨在评价临床第二种意见,作为完整的决策支持文物,而不是单一诊断答案。 它的8个响应质量标准分别衡量一个模型是否正确使用提供的事实,识别临床问题并确定其优先顺序,整合相关数据,构建连贯的推理,发展出适当的差分诊断,得出校正结论,提出可操作管理计划,并解决安全问题. 这一概况使得有可能将能够产生流利诊断推理的模型与能够将这种推理转化为有根据、可用和安全的临床推荐的模型区分开来。

blocks.en: The two evaluation checkpoints add a second level of resolution. Retaining the primary-role opinion before consilium and evaluating the final multidisciplinary synthesis on the same cases makes it possible to determine whether the complete synthesis pipeline adds value and which clinical dimensions change. Likewise, applying free-form and structured conditions to the same case–model panels separates a broad response-format effect from the substantially larger effect of model identity. Table 6 demonstrates this capability directly: it recovers a stable model hierarchy while Table 8 shows that the apparent advantage of structured reports is specifically concentrated in management rather than distributed uniformly across the rubric.
blocks.zh: 这两个评估检查站增加了二级决议。 在 consilium 之前保留初级-作用意见并评价关于相同案例的最后多学科综合,从而有可能确定完整的合成管道是否增加价值以及临床维度的变化。 同样,将自由形式和结构化条件适用于同一案例的模型板将广义的响应形式效应与模型特征的显著较大效应区分开来。 表6直接显示了这种能力:它恢复了稳定的模式等级,而表8显示,结构化报告的明显优势是专门集中在管理层,而不是在标题上统一分布。

blocks.en: Finally, the benchmark records the process that produces the final answer. First-round dissent, consensus frequency, review rounds, the distinct finalization stage, and token use are reported alongside clinical-quality scores. This makes it possible to distinguish procedural agreement from output quality and to identify configurations, such as GPT-5.6-Sol, that combine strong clinical scores with rapid convergence. Together, these features provide a comprehensive and extensible framework for comparing clinically relevant model capabilities, prompting strategies, and synthesis pipelines without reducing performance to diagnostic accuracy alone.
blocks.zh: 最后,基准记录产生最后答案的过程。 第一轮异议、协商一致频率、审查回合、独特的定稿阶段和象征性用途与临床质量分数一样。 这使得可以将程序协议与产出质量区分开来,并确定组合,如GPT-5.6-Sol,将强临床分数与快趋同相结合. 这些特征共同提供了一个全面而可扩展的框架,用以比较临床上相关的模型能力、推动战略以及合成管道,同时又不将性能降低到仅诊断准确性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This benchmark provides a multidimensional evaluation of LLM-generated clinical second opinions across factual grounding, problem prioritization, data use, reasoning coherence, differential diagnosis, final-conclusion quality, management, and safety. On the same 190 held-out cases, it distinguished a stable hierarchy among eight model pipelines, separated model capability from response-format effects, and quantified the contribution of the complete multidisciplinary synthesis. The structured final consilium report was more highly rated than the pre-consilium primary-role opinion across every shared criterion, while structured reports achieved higher overall means in seven of eight models, primarily through improved management planning. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds.
blocks.zh: 这一基准提供了对LLM生成的临床第二意见的多层面评价,涉及事实基础、问题优先排序、数据使用、推理一致性、差异诊断、最终结论质量、管理和安全。 在同样的190起搁置案件中,它区分了8个模型管道之间的稳定分级,将模型能力与响应-格式效应分开,并量化了完整的多学科综合的贡献. 结构化最后报告的评级高于每一种共同标准在结构化前的主要作用意见,而结构化报告主要通过改进管理规划,在8个模式中的7个模式中实现了更高的总体手段。 GPT-5.6-Sol领导了每一个被评价的部分,并在最少几轮审查中达成共识.

blocks.en: These results show that a clinically informative benchmark can capture differences that diagnostic accuracy alone would miss: whether a model can transform case information and multiple perspectives into a grounded, coherent, actionable, and safe second opinion. At the same time, structured reporting increased inference requirements, and additional review rounds were not associated with higher final-report scores. Clinical quality, procedural convergence, response structure, and inference cost should therefore be evaluated as complementary outcomes. The benchmark offers a comprehensive framework for comparing future models and synthesis strategies, while prospective studies remain necessary to establish effects on clinician decisions and patient care.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,临床信息化的基准可以捕捉诊断准确性本身会错过的区别:一个模型是否能够将案例信息和多重视角转化为有根据的、连贯的、可操作的和安全的第二意见。 与此同时,结构化报告增加了推论要求,额外的审查周期与最后报告分数较高无关。 因此,临床质量、程序趋同、反应结构和推论成本应作为补充结果加以评价。 该基准为比较未来的模型和综合战略提供了一个全面的框架,同时仍然需要进行预期的研究,以确定对临床医生的决定和病人护理的影响。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: NEJM Case Records overrepresent unusual, difficult cases and do not reproduce routine prevalence, documentation, time pressure, or longitudinal uncertainty. Their published diagnoses are useful targets but not exhaustive ground truth for management. The public cases may also have appeared in model training data; because DOI and title were supplied before the consilium, we cannot separate memorization from de novo reasoning. Finally, prompted roles are simulated perspectives, not independently validated specialists, and may share correlated errors.
blocks.zh: 纽约 案例记录过多地呈现出不寻常的,困难的病例,不重复常规的流行,文件,时间压力,或纵向的不确定性. 他们发表的诊断是有用的目标,但并非管理层所了解的全部事实。 公共案件也可能出现在模型培训数据中;因为DOI和标题是在consilium之前提供的,所以我们不能将记忆和再推理分开. 最后,被激发的角色是模拟的视角,而不是独立验证的专家,并可能分享相关错误.

blocks.en: The consilium used more calls, context, and tokens than a standalone opinion, without a compute-matched design that could isolate sampling, review, and interaction. The structured condition also changed instructions, output length, and downstream context, so observed differences cannot be attributed to format alone.
blocks.zh: 缩写比独立的意见还多使用调用,上下文和符号,没有可以隔离采样,审查和相互作用的计算相匹配的设计. 结构条件也改变了指令,输出长度,下游上下文,因此所观察到的差异不能单独归因于格式.

blocks.en: Judge scores may reflect knowledge, style preferences, or failure modes shared with evaluated models; GPT-OSS-120B also judged its own outputs. Calibration used a limited physician-rated sample, error varied by criterion, and several evolved prompts showed semantic drift. The rubric was not externally validated, the held-out cohort was published later than the reference cohort, and exclusion of non-evaluable scores could affect means. Panel size showed little variation. Most importantly, we evaluated artifacts rather than effects on clinician behavior, workflow, or patient outcomes.
blocks.zh: 评委分数可能反映与被评价模型共享的知识,风格偏好,或失败模式;GPT-OSS-120B也判断自己的产出. 校正使用一个有限的医师分级样本,错误因标准而异,几个演化的提示显示语义漂移. 标题没有经过外部验证,被搁置组的出版时间晚于参考组的出版时间,排除非可评价分数可能影响手段. 小组的规模几乎没有变化。 最重要的是,我们评价了文物,而不是对临床医生的行为、工作流程或病人结果的影响。

blocks.en:
An 8-year-old boy was seen in an outpatient clinic of this hospital
because of an enlarging mass in the right breast.
blocks.zh:
这家医院的门诊部看到一个8岁的男孩
因为右乳房中弥漫出质

blocks.en:
One week before this presentation, the patient was seen by a
pediatrician at another medical facility for a routine annual
examination. He had a history of a mass in his right breast that had
been present for 18 months and had recently enlarged. On examination, a
round, mobile mass was palpable under the right areola. He was referred
to the pediatric endocrinology clinic of this hospital.
blocks.zh:
在演讲前一个星期,一名医生看到病人。
每年在另一个医疗机构做例行的儿科医生
考试。 他的右胸有一次弥撒的历史
在那里呆了18个月,最近又扩大了规模。 检查时,a
轮回,移动质量 可见在右等离子体下。 他被转诊了
去医院的儿科内分泌诊所

blocks.en:
One week later, at the visit to the endocrinology clinic, the patient’s
parents reported that, approximately 18 months earlier, they had noted a
mass under the right nipple that was not associated with discharge. The
mass had reportedly enlarged in the 6 months before this presentation,
and growth of fine pubic hair was also noted. The patient had seasonal
allergies and eczema and was otherwise well. He had a history of normal
growth and development. His only medication was topical triamcinolone
cream for eczema; his childhood vaccinations were current. He had no
known allergies to medications. He lived with his parents and younger
sibling and was doing well in second grade. His maternal grandfather had
asthma, his maternal grandmother had hypercholesterolemia, and his
paternal grandmother had breast cancer (which had been diagnosed when
she was 70 years of age); his parents and younger sibling were healthy.

Laboratory Data. On examination, the patient did not have dysmorphic
features. The blood pressure was 110/70 mm Hg, the pulse 86 beats per
minute, the height 131 cm (68th percentile), the weight 28.4 kg (72nd
percentile), and the body-mass index (BMI; the weight in kilograms
divided by the square of the height in meters) 16.5 (66th percentile).
The abdomen was soft and had some palpable bowel loops. A firm, mobile
mass (2 cm by 2 cm) was present under the right areola and was not
adherent to the skin. A small amount of soft breast tissue was palpable
on the left side. Fine, straight, lightly pigmented hairs were present
on the lower mons pubis, and on close inspection, very scant fine, light
axillary hairs were also present. The testes had an estimated volume of
3 ml; the phallus was prepubertal. The remainder of the examination was
normal. Findings on a radiograph of the left hand were consistent with a
bone age of 8 years. Eight days after this visit, laboratory tests were
performed; the test results are shown in Table 1. Thirteen days after
this visit, imaging studies of the chest were performed.

Ultrasound Images of the Breasts. Dr. Pallavi Sagar: Ultrasound
examination of the right breast (Figure 1) revealed a
well-circumscribed, oval-shaped, relatively hypoechoic, mobile mass
(measuring approximately 1.4 cm by 1.3 cm by 0.8 cm) with
through-transmission in the retroareolar region. The mass had smooth
peripheral margins and was superficial to the pectoralis muscle; its
long axis was parallel to the skin and horizontal in orientation. On
color Doppler imaging, the mass was relatively hypovascular and had
minimal peripheral-blood flow. The mass did not have irregular
spiculated margins, calcifications, or increased vascularity, features
that are typically seen in aggressive cancerous lesions. Examination of
the contralateral breast revealed a normal left breast bud.

blocks.en: C.3.3 Overall Rationale
blocks.zh: C.3.3 总体理由

blocks.en:
A prepubertal boy with an enlarging breast mass and early pubertal signs
requires an endocrine-led evaluation, imaging characterization, tissue
diagnosis, and surgical management to establish etiology and direct
therapy.
blocks.zh:
乳房前的男孩 乳房质量和早期阴道
需要进行内分泌导向评估、成像特征鉴定、组织
诊断和外科手术管理,以建立病理并指导
治疗。

blocks.en:
Clinical and Imaging Context An 8-year-old boy presents with an
18-month history of a right retroareolar breast mass that has enlarged
over the past 6 months. Physical examination reveals a 2 × \times 2 cm firm,
mobile, non-skin-fixed mass, along with a small left breast bud, fine
pubic hair, scant axillary hair, and prepubertal testes (3 mL). Bone age
is concordant with chronological age (8 years). Ultrasound demonstrates
a well-circumscribed, oval, hypoechoic, hypovascular mass with
through-transmission and no suspicious features (spiculation,
calcifications, or marked hypervascularity).

blocks.en:
Pathological Differential Diagnosis Based on the clinical and
sonographic presentation, the primary considerations include:
blocks.zh:
根据临床和医学诊断结果,
主要考虑因素包括:

blocks.en:
1. Asymmetric/Prepubertal Gynecomastia: The most common breast
pathology in males. The presence of a contralateral breast bud
supports an underlying bilateral process with asymmetric clinical
presentation. Expected histology would show ductal epithelial
hyperplasia with periductal stromal edema and fibrosis, depending on
the phase (florid vs. fibrous). 2. Juvenile (Cellular) Fibroadenoma: Rare in prepubertal males
but well-described. The discrete, well-circumscribed, oval sonographic
appearance is classic for a benign fibroepithelial lesion. Histology
would demonstrate a biphasic proliferation of stromal and glandular
elements. 3. Secretory Carcinoma (Juvenile Breast Carcinoma): A rare,
low-grade malignancy that can occur in children. It must be excluded
in any pediatric male breast mass because it can present with
deceptively benign, well-circumscribed imaging features. 4. Other rare entities: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia
(PASH), phyllodes tumor, or benign mesenchymal lesions (e.g., lipoma,
granular cell tumor) are less likely but remain in the differential.

Resolution of Diagnostic Approach: Tissue Sampling There is a
divergence in the preconcilium opinions regarding the necessity of a
biopsy. One opinion suggests that the clinical and sonographic findings
alone are sufficient to diagnose prepubertal gynecomastia without tissue
sampling. However, the safer and more robust pathology consensus is that
a progressively enlarging, discrete, unilateral breast mass in a
prepubertal male warrants definitive tissue characterization. Relying
solely on imaging risks missing rare but clinically significant
entities, such as secretory carcinoma or juvenile fibroadenoma.
Therefore, tissue diagnosis is recommended.

Preliminary Pathologic Impression and Recommendations The
imaging features are reassuringly benign, favoring an epithelial-stromal
process such as asymmetric gynecomastia or a fibroadenoma. However, a
definitive benign diagnosis cannot be rendered without histopathologic
examination.

blocks.en: Recommendations:
blocks.zh: 建议:

blocks.en:
• Tissue Acquisition: An excisional biopsy is preferred to
evaluate the complete architecture, though an image-guided core needle
biopsy is an acceptable alternative. Fine-needle aspiration is
generally inadequate for this differential. • Histologic Evaluation: Focus on distinguishing biphasic
benign patterns (gynecomastia vs. fibroadenoma) and identifying
secretory morphology to rule out secretory carcinoma. Assess for
papillary hyperplasia, atypia, or invasive growth. • Immunohistochemistry/Molecular Testing: Utilize myoepithelial
markers (p63, SMA) to confirm the benign nature of glandular
structures. If secretory carcinoma is suspected, perform ETV6
break-apart FISH or relevant IHC. ER/PR and Ki-67 can help
characterize proliferative activity. • Clinicopathologic Correlation: Once available, correlate the
histology with the pending laboratory studies (Table 1) to rule out an
underlying endocrine or gonadal/adrenal neoplasm driving secondary
gynecomastia.

blocks.en:
Clinical Summary An 8-year-old boy presents with an 18-month
history of a right retroareolar breast mass that has enlarged over the
past 6 months. He has recently developed fine, straight, lightly
pigmented pubic hair and scant axillary hair. His growth parameters
(height 68th percentile, weight 72nd percentile) and bone age (8 years)
are appropriate for his chronological age. Examination reveals a 2 × \times 2
cm firm, mobile, non-adherent right subareolar mass, a small left breast
bud, and prepubertal testes (3 mL) and phallus. Breast ultrasound
demonstrates a well-circumscribed, oval, hypoechoic, hypovascular mass
with through-transmission and no malignant features.

Leydig/Sertoli cell tumor, mediastinal germinoma, adrenal neoplasm).
These can present with gynecomastia and may initially have subtle
systemic signs, though the normal bone age and growth velocity are
reassuring against a long-standing, high-grade hormonal excess. • Primary breast neoplasms (e.g., juvenile fibroadenoma,
secretory carcinoma). These are exceedingly rare, and the current
ultrasound features are reassuring, but they remain in the
differential if the mass exhibits atypical growth or if endocrine
evaluation is entirely unrevealing.

blocks.en: Recommendations
blocks.zh: 建议

blocks.en:
1. Laboratory Interpretation Framework: • If gonadotropins (LH, FSH) and testosterone are prepubertal,
estradiol is normal/low, and tumor markers ( β \beta -hCG, AFP) are
negative, the diagnosis of benign prepubertal gynecomastia with
adrenarche is supported. • If estradiol is elevated with suppressed gonadotropins, urgent
localization via testicular ultrasound and adrenal/chest imaging is
required. • If DHEAS/androstenedione are elevated with prepubertal testosterone,
this confirms adrenarche and argues against a gonadal or hCG-driven
process. 2. Imaging: Review the pending chest imaging. Obtain a
high-resolution scrotal/testicular ultrasound to exclude occult
testicular pathology. 3. Management: If the laboratory and imaging evaluations are
reassuring, expectant management with reassurance is
appropriate. The family should be counseled that prepubertal/early
pubertal gynecomastia is common and often self-limited. The family
history of late-onset breast cancer in the paternal grandmother does
not alter management or increase the risk of pediatric breast
pathology. 4. Follow-up: Re-evaluate every 3 to 6 months, assessing
auxology, Tanner staging, testicular volumes, and mass size. 5. Surgical Referral: Routine fine-needle aspiration or
immediate biopsy is not indicated given the classic presentation and
reassuring ultrasound. However, referral to pediatric surgery for
tissue diagnosis (core-needle or excisional biopsy) should be pursued
if the mass continues to enlarge significantly, becomes fixed or
painful, develops suspicious sonographic features, or persists without
regression beyond 24 months despite a benign endocrine workup.

blocks.en:
Clinical Summary An 8-year-old boy presents with an 18-month
history of a unilateral right retroareolar breast mass that has enlarged
over the preceding 6 months. He exhibits early signs of adrenarche (fine
pubic and scant axillary hair) but has prepubertal testes (3 mL) and a
bone age concordant with his chronologic age (8 years). Breast
ultrasound reveals a well-circumscribed, oval, hypoechoic, mobile,
hypovascular mass (1.4 × \times 1.3 × \times 0.8 cm) with smooth margins and posterior
acoustic enhancement, oriented parallel to the skin. No suspicious
features (spiculation, calcifications, increased vascularity) are noted.

阴毛和短轴毛),但具有前卵睾(3毫升)和a

超声波显示一个 周密的,椭圆的,低血压的,移动的,
具有平滑边沿和后缘的下血管质量(1.4 ×\times 1.3 ×\times 0.8 cm)
声学增强,方向与皮肤平行. 无可疑
特征(示意图、钙化、增加血管)被注意。

blocks.en:
Imaging and Diagnostic Interpretation There is uniform
agreement that the sonographic features are reassuring and consistent
with a benign process. However, there is a divergence in interpretation
regarding the specific etiology:

characteristic of a benign solid breast neoplasm, such as a juvenile

blocks.en: Surgical Perspective and Recommendations
blocks.zh: 手术视角和建议

blocks.en:
1. Endocrine Evaluation First: All opinions concur that the
missing laboratory data (Table 1) and the results of the "diagnostic
procedures" are critical. Before proceeding to the operating room, the
endocrine workup (including gonadotropins, sex steroids, adrenal
androgens, and tumor markers) must be reviewed to rule out an
extra-mammary hormone-secreting tumor (e.g., testicular, adrenal, or
hCG-secreting tumor) that could be driving the breast changes. 2. Excisional Biopsy vs. Observation: While observation is a
reasonable approach for classic physiologic gynecomastia, the 18-month
duration, recent enlargement, and discrete sonographic morphology make
continued observation less appropriate. If the endocrine evaluation
does not reveal a systemic cause requiring primary medical management,
an excisional biopsy is recommended for definitive histologic
diagnosis and treatment. 3. Surgical Approach: If excision is indicated, a circumareolar
or subareolar (Webster-type) incision is preferred for optimal
cosmetic outcomes. The mass should be completely excised with a thin
rim of surrounding tissue and sent for permanent histopathology to
rule out rare pediatric malignancies (e.g., secretory carcinoma) and
confirm benign pathology (e.g., fibroadenoma). Frozen section is
generally unnecessary given the benign imaging characteristics but may
be utilized if intraoperative findings are suspicious.

Bottom Line The clinical and sonographic findings are most
consistent with a benign solid breast lesion, such as a fibroadenoma,
rather than physiologic gynecomastia. Given the prolonged duration and
recent growth, surgical excision via a circumareolar approach is
recommended for definitive diagnosis and treatment, provided the pending
endocrine evaluation does not reveal a primary systemic etiology.

blocks.en: C.4.4 Radiology
blocks.zh: C.4.4 放射学

blocks.en: Consolidated Radiology Second Opinion
blocks.zh: 二号意见

blocks.en:
Imaging Summary The available breast ultrasound demonstrates a
well-circumscribed, oval, relatively hypoechoic solid mass in the right
retroareolar region (approximately 1.4 × \times 1.3 × \times 0.8 cm). The lesion is
oriented parallel to the skin, is mobile, and demonstrates posterior
acoustic enhancement (through-transmission). Color Doppler imaging
reveals minimal peripheral flow and no internal hypervascularity. There
are no suspicious features such as spiculated margins,
microcalcifications, or non-parallel orientation. The left breast
demonstrates a normal prepubertal bud. Left-hand radiograph indicates a
bone age of 8 years, concordant with the patient’s chronological age.
blocks.zh:
图像摘要 乳房超声波显示
右侧环状、椭圆形、相对低温固体质量
retroareolar 区域(约1.4 ×\时 1.3 ×\时0.8厘米). 损伤是
与皮肤相平行,具有移动性,并显示后发性
声学增强(通过-传输). 颜色多普勒成像
揭示出最小的外围流动 和没有内高血管。 那边
没有可疑特征,如相片边缘,
微观计算,或非平行取向. 左边的乳房
展示出一个正常的乳前花芽. 左手无线电指
骨龄为8岁,与病人的时间年龄一致。

blocks.en:
Consolidated Impression and Differential Diagnosis The
sonographic morphology is overwhelmingly benign, with no features to
suggest a primary breast malignancy (such as secretory carcinoma) or an
aggressive neoplastic process.
blocks.zh:
综合印象和差别诊断 这个
声学形态非常良性,没有特征
说明主要乳腺恶性(如分泌性癌)或
充满活力的新塑料工艺

blocks.en:
The primary diagnostic consideration is asymmetric
gynecomastia . The retroareolar location, in conjunction with the
patient's early signs of puberty (fine pubic and
axillary hair), strongly supports a hormonally driven proliferation of
ductal and stromal tissue. While classic gynecomastia often appears as a
flame-shaped or diffuse area of retroareolar tissue, early or asymmetric
presentations can occasionally manifest as a discrete, oval, mass-like
nodule.

blocks.en:
• No immediate additional breast imaging is required. The
current ultrasound features are reassuring and do not warrant
immediate MRI or biopsy. • Clinical and endocrinological correlation is paramount. Management hinges on the results of the laboratory panel. • Short-interval follow-up: If the endocrine workup confirms a
benign pubertal variant and the mass remains clinically stable, a
follow-up breast ultrasound in 3 to 6 months is recommended to
document stability or regression. • Tissue diagnosis: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy or
excisional biopsy should be reserved for scenarios where the mass
demonstrates rapid or continued enlargement, develops atypical
sonographic features (e.g., irregular margins, internal
hypervascularity, non-parallel orientation), or if the endocrine
evaluation fails to support a benign hormonal etiology.

blocks.en:
Clinical Summary An 8-year-old boy presents with an 18-month
history of a right retroareolar breast mass that has enlarged over the
preceding 6 months. He has recently developed fine, lightly pigmented
pubic hair and scant axillary hair. Physical examination reveals a 2 × \times 2
cm firm, mobile, non-adherent right subareolar mass, a small left breast
bud, and prepubertal testes (3 mL) and phallus. His growth parameters
and bone age (8 years) are concordant with his chronological age. Breast
ultrasound demonstrates a well-circumscribed, oval, hypoechoic, mobile
mass (1.4 × \times 1.3 × \times 0.8 cm) with through-transmission, parallel
orientation to the skin, and minimal peripheral blood flow. There are no
sonographic features of aggressive malignancy (e.g., spiculation,
calcifications, marked hypervascularity).

Specialist Perspectives and Differential Diagnosis The
specialist opinions align on the benign nature of the imaging findings
but diverge on the primary etiology and the necessity of immediate
tissue sampling:

专家观点和差别诊断 这个
专家意见符合成像结果的良性性质
但是在初级病原学和立即
组织取样:

blocks.en:
• Asymmetric Gynecomastia vs. Benign Neoplasm: Pediatric
Endocrinology and Radiology favor asymmetric benign gynecomastia
occurring in the setting of isolated premature adrenarche, citing the
contralateral breast bud, early secondary sexual characteristics, and
reassuring ultrasound. In contrast, Pediatric Surgery and Pathology
emphasize the discrete, oval, well-circumscribed morphology of the
mass and its 18-month duration with recent growth, which they find
atypical for classic physiologic gynecomastia and more suggestive of a
benign solid neoplasm, such as a juvenile fibroadenoma. Pathology also
notes that rare malignancies, such as secretory carcinoma, must be
excluded. • Tissue Sampling vs. Observation: Endocrinology and Radiology
recommend expectant management with short-interval follow-up (3–6
months) if the pending endocrine evaluation is reassuring, reserving
biopsy for atypical sonographic changes or continued significant
growth. Surgery and Pathology recommend proceeding to tissue diagnosis
(excisional or core needle biopsy) to definitively characterize the
lesion and rule out rare pediatric breast neoplasms, provided no
systemic endocrine cause is identified.

An 8-year-old boy was seen in an outpatient clinic of this hospital
because of an enlarging mass in the right breast.

blocks.en:
One week before this presentation, the patient was seen by a
pediatrician at another medical facility for a routine annual
examination. He had a history of a mass in his right breast that had
been present for 18 months and had recently enlarged. On examination, a
round, mobile mass was palpable under the right areola. He was referred
to the pediatric endocrinology clinic of this hospital.

mass under the right nipple that was not associated with discharge. The
mass had reportedly enlarged in the 6 months before this presentation,

asthma, his maternal grandmother had hypercholesterolemia, and his
paternal grandmother had breast cancer (which had been diagnosed when
she was 70 years of age); his parents and younger sibling were healthy.

A prepubertal boy with an enlarging breast mass and early pubertal signs
requires an endocrine-led evaluation, imaging characterization, tissue
diagnosis, and surgical management to establish etiology and direct
therapy.

blocks.en:
Approximately 18 months before presentation (2016), the parents noted a
mass under the right nipple with no associated discharge (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: establishes chronicity and
absence of inflammatory or malignant discharge signs. Approximately 6
months before presentation, the mass enlarged and growth of fine pubic
hair was noted (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: suggests
recent hormonal influence and possible adrenarche. One week before
presentation, a pediatrician palpated a round, mobile right retroareolar
mass on routine examination and referred the patient to pediatric
endocrinology (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: confirms a
discrete mass requiring specialist evaluation. At the endocrinology
clinic visit (2016), physical examination revealed a firm, mobile 2 cm
by 2 cm mass under the right areola, not adherent to skin; a small
amount of soft breast tissue on the left; fine, straight, lightly
pigmented pubic hairs on the lower mons pubis and scant fine axillary
hairs; testes 3 ml with prepubertal phallus; height 131 cm (68th
percentile), weight 28.4 kg (72nd percentile), BMI 16.5 (66th
percentile); blood pressure 110/70 mm Hg, pulse 86 bpm; no dysmorphic
features (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: unilateral, firm
mass with early pubic/axillary hair but prepubertal testes indicates
isolated premature adrenarche, not central precocious puberty.
Radiograph of the left hand: bone age 8 years, consistent with
chronological age (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: no
advanced skeletal maturation, arguing against sustained estrogenic or
gonadal exposure. Eight days after the visit, laboratory tests were
performed; results are in Table 1 but not provided in the supplied text
(DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: hormonal profile unknown, a
critical data gap. Thirteen days after the visit, breast ultrasound
revealed a well-circumscribed, oval, hypoechoic, mobile retroareolar
mass measuring 1.4 x 1.3 x 0.8 cm, with smooth margins,
through-transmission, horizontal orientation, superficial to pectoralis,
and minimal peripheral color Doppler flow; no spiculated margins,
calcifications, or hypervascularity; left breast showed a normal bud
(DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: benign imaging features
make malignancy unlikely but do not replace histology. Diagnostic
procedures were performed (likely biopsy/excision), but results are not
yet available (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: tissue
diagnosis pending, which is the definitive step. Past medical history
includes seasonal allergies and eczema treated with topical
triamcinolone; no other medications or endocrine disorders (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: no exogenous hormone exposure or
chronic disease. Family history includes paternal grandmother with
breast cancer at age 70; no known familial endocrine tumor syndromes
(DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Significance: limited relevance given
late-onset breast cancer in a female relative.

blocks.en:
The primary syndrome is a localized retroareolar proliferative lesion in
a prepubertal male. It is confirmed by an 18-month history of a firm,
mobile, 2 cm right retroareolar mass (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ) and a
corresponding well-circumscribed, hypoechoic, hypovascular sonographic
nodule measuring 1.4 x 1.3 x 0.8 cm with smooth margins and
through-transmission (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). The pathogenetic
mechanism involves localized proliferation of ductal and stromal
elements within the breast bud, either as a hormonally influenced benign
process (prepubertal gynecomastia) or as a benign biphasic neoplasm
(fibroadenoma). The presence of fine pubic and axillary hair with
prepubertal testes (3 ml) and normal bone age indicates isolated
premature adrenarche (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). This peripheral
androgenic activity may contribute to breast tissue stimulation via
aromatization, but the absence of central puberty suggests the hormonal
influence is limited. A malignant infiltrative syndrome is rejected on
imaging grounds because the mass lacks spiculated margins,
calcifications, and increased vascularity, and there is no skin fixation
(DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). However, imaging alone cannot exclude
rare low-grade malignancies such as secretory carcinoma, which can
present as a well-circumscribed mass in children.

blocks.en:
High probability: Prepubertal gynecomastia. Arguments for: most common
cause of male pediatric breast masses; retroareolar location; small
breast tissue also noted on the left; sonographic features consistent
with benign glandular tissue (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Arguments
against: the mass is distinctly nodular and firm rather than the typical
diffuse discoid subareolar plaque, and there is no reported tenderness.
Confirmation: histology showing benign ductal proliferation with
periductal stromal proliferation without atypia, correlated with normal
or mildly altered estrogen-to-androgen ratio. Refutation: histology
showing a biphasic neoplasm or malignancy. High probability:
Fibroadenoma. Arguments for: sonographic
appearance—well-circumscribed, oval, smooth-margined, horizontally
oriented, mobile—is classic for fibroadenoma (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Arguments against: rare in prepubertal males.
Confirmation: histology demonstrating a benign biphasic tumor with
intracanalicular or pericanalicular architecture. Medium probability:
Lipoma or other benign mesenchymal lesion. Arguments for:
well-circumscribed, mobile, hypoechoic mass. Arguments against:
retroareolar location is less typical, and the mass is hypoechoic rather
than classically hyperechoic. Confirmation: histology showing mature
adipose or benign mesenchymal tissue. Low probability but must be
excluded: Secretory carcinoma (juvenile breast carcinoma). Arguments
for: rare malignant breast tumor of childhood presenting as a painless
mass. Arguments against: no sonographic malignant features (no
spiculation, no increased vascularity, no calcifications), no skin
fixation (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Confirmation/exclusion:
histopathology and, if morphology is suspicious, molecular testing for
the characteristic ETV6-NTRK3 translocation. Low probability: Estrogen-
or hCG-secreting tumor (testicular, adrenal, hepatic). Arguments for:
prepubertal male with breast mass. Arguments against: symmetric
prepubertal testes, no abdominal mass, no dysmorphic features (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Confirmation: elevated beta-hCG, estradiol, or
imaging lesion. Refutation: prepubertal gonadotropins, normal estradiol,
beta-hCG, and testicular ultrasound.

blocks.en:
Diagnostics: Tissue diagnosis is mandatory to resolve the differential
and exclude malignancy. An ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy is the
initial pathologic procedure, with the goal of obtaining adequate tissue
for histology and immunohistochemistry while minimizing cosmetic
morbidity. Expected result: benign breast tissue consistent with
gynecomastia or fibroadenoma. If core needle biopsy is nondiagnostic or
shows atypia, an excisional biopsy should follow. If histology confirms
benign gynecomastia or fibroadenoma, observation or limited surgical
excision may follow based on symptoms. If secretory carcinoma or sarcoma
is identified, oncologic surgical planning with margin control and
staging is required. Histologic evaluation must assess for ductal versus
stromal predominance, cytologic atypia, infiltrative growth,
lymphovascular invasion, and mitotic activity. Immunohistochemistry
(e.g., S100, cytokeratins, ER, PR, myoepithelial markers) should be
performed if morphology is atypical. Radiologic-pathologic concordance
is mandatory: if imaging suggests benignity but pathology is discordant,
repeat biopsy or excision is required. Additionally, obtain the full
numeric results of Table 1 (LH, FSH, estradiol, testosterone, DHEA-S,
17-hydroxyprogesterone, beta-hCG, TSH, free T4, prolactin) to determine
whether the gonadal axis is prepubertal and to screen for an hCG- or
estrogen-secreting tumor. If basal LH is borderline or clinical
progression occurs, a GnRH stimulation test may be considered to exclude
central precocious puberty. Testicular ultrasound should be performed to
exclude a subclinical gonadal tumor if hormonal results are abnormal.
Treatment: If histology confirms prepubertal gynecomastia, no further
pathologic intervention is needed; clinical observation and endocrine
follow-up are managed by pediatrics and endocrinology. If fibroadenoma
is confirmed, simple excision is curative if symptomatic or growing. If
secretory carcinoma or sarcoma is diagnosed, ensure adequate margin
assessment on the excision specimen and coordinate sentinel lymph node
evaluation per pediatric oncology protocols. The surgical goal in any
excision is complete removal with preservation of the nipple-areolar
complex and developing breast tissue. Adjacent specialties: pediatric
endocrinology to provide the complete hormone panel and manage
adrenarche; pediatric radiology for image-guided biopsy and concordance
review; pediatric surgery for excisional biopsy or definitive resection;
pediatric oncology if malignancy is identified.

blocks.en:
This 8-year-old boy presents with an 18-month history of a right
retroareolar mass that recently enlarged, now measuring 2 cm clinically
and 1.4 x 1.3 x 0.8 cm sonographically, in the setting of peripheral
adrenarche (fine pubic and axillary hair) but prepubertal testicular
volume (3 ml) and normal bone age (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). The
leading pathologic considerations are benign localized
proliferations—most likely prepubertal gynecomastia or a
fibroadenoma—given the retroareolar location, patient age, smooth
sonographic margins, and absence of malignant imaging features (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). However, rare pediatric breast malignancies,
particularly secretory carcinoma, must be excluded because clinical and
imaging benignity cannot guarantee benign histology in this age group.
The priority action is to obtain a definitive tissue diagnosis via
ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy or excisional biopsy, with
permanent sections and appropriate immunohistochemical or molecular
studies if indicated. Concurrently, the missing endocrine laboratory
values from Table 1 must be reviewed to correlate any hormonal influence
with the histopathologic findings. The most impactful data gaps are the
unavailable endocrine laboratory values and the pending histopathologic
results, both of which are required to distinguish a hormonally driven
benign process from a neoplasm and to guide whether simple observation,
local excision, or oncologic staging is appropriate (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ).

blocks.en:
Approximately 18 months before presentation (date not specified), the
parents noted a mass under the right nipple without discharge (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). This establishes chronicity and absence of
inflammatory or galactorrheic features. Six months before presentation,
the mass began to enlarge, and growth of fine pubic hair was noted,
indicating recent acceleration and possible hormonal influence (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). One week prior to the endocrinology evaluation,
a pediatrician palpated a round, mobile mass under the right areola and
referred the patient (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). At the endocrinology
clinic visit in 2016, the patient had a history of normal growth and
development, seasonal allergies, and eczema treated with topical
triamcinolone cream; family history included paternal grandmother with
breast cancer at age 70 (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). This largely
excludes exogenous systemic hormone exposure and suggests low-risk
family history. On examination, blood pressure was 110/70 mm Hg, pulse
86 beats per minute, height 131 cm (68th percentile), weight 28.4 kg
(72nd percentile), and BMI 16.5 (66th percentile), indicating normal
growth without obesity (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). A firm, mobile 2
cm by 2 cm mass was present under the right areola and was not adherent
to the skin, while a small amount of soft breast tissue was palpable on
the left, signifying bilateral but asymmetric gynecomastia (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Fine, straight, lightly pigmented hairs were
present on the lower mons pubis and very scant fine axillary hairs were
noted, but the testes were 3 mL and the phallus was prepubertal,
signifying adrenarche without gonadarche (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ).
Bone age by left hand radiograph was 8 years, consistent with
chronological age and arguing against significant systemic estrogen
effect (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Eight days after the visit,
laboratory tests were drawn (Table 1), but the specific values are not
provided in the supplied text, representing a critical data gap (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Thirteen days after the visit, chest imaging
studies were performed, but results are not provided, leaving evaluation
for ectopic hCG-secreting tumors incomplete (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Ultrasound of the right breast revealed a
well-circumscribed, oval, hypoechoic, mobile retroareolar mass measuring
approximately 1.4 cm by 1.3 cm by 0.8 cm with smooth margins, minimal
peripheral vascularity, and no calcifications, spiculation, or increased
vascularity; the left breast showed a normal bud (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). These sonographic features are significant
because they are classic for benign glandular tissue and argue against
aggressive malignancy. Diagnostic procedures were performed
(unspecified), representing another critical data gap (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Important negative findings include: no nipple
discharge, no skin adherence or retraction, no dysmorphic features, no
testicular enlargement, no advanced bone age, and no malignant
ultrasound characteristics.

blocks.en:
The main syndrome is unilateral prepubertal gynecomastia with a
contralateral breast bud. It is confirmed by an 18-month history of a
right subareolar mass that enlarged over 6 months, a firm mobile 2x2 cm
right retroareolar mass on exam, and a sonographically
well-circumscribed hypoechoic retroareolar mass with benign features
(DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). The mechanism is proliferation of ductal
and periductal fibroglandular tissue driven by an imbalance between
estrogen and androgen action at the breast bud. In this prepubertal boy
with normal bone age and prepubertal testes, any estrogenic drive is
likely peripheral (adrenal, exogenous, or increased aromatization)
rather than centrally mediated. A concurrent syndrome is premature
adrenarche, confirmed by fine pubic and scant axillary hair with
prepubertal 3 ml testes and a prepubertal phallus (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). This is realized through adrenal zona
reticularis secretion of weak androgens (DHEA/DHEA-S) independent of
gonadotropin stimulation. Central precocious puberty is rejected because
testicular volume is 3 ml (prepubertal), the phallus is prepubertal, and
bone age is not advanced, which are incompatible with central HPG axis
activation.

blocks.en:
High probability: Idiopathic or early physiologic prepubertal
gynecomastia associated with premature adrenarche. For: classic clinical
and sonographic features, prepubertal gonadarche, normal growth and bone
age. Against: persistence for 18 months with recent enlargement is
unusual for typical physiologic prepubertal gynecomastia. Confirm:
normal basal labs and stability/regression on follow-up. Refute:
elevated sex steroids or tumor localization. Medium probability:
Peripheral estrogen excess due to occult testicular or adrenal neoplasm.
For: unilateral enlarging gynecomastia suggests active hormonal
stimulation. Against: no palpable testicular or abdominal mass, normal
bone age. Confirm: elevated estradiol with suppressed LH/FSH,
testicular/adrenal imaging. Refute: normal imaging and estradiol. Low
probability (must exclude): hCG-secreting germ cell tumor (testicular,
mediastinal, CNS). For: can cause gynecomastia via Leydig cell
stimulation. Against: no testicular mass, no neurologic/respiratory
symptoms. Confirm: elevated hCG, imaging. Refute: undetectable hCG,
normal imaging. Low probability: Late-onset congenital adrenal
hyperplasia (CAH). For: premature pubic hair. Against: normal bone age,
no virilization, gynecomastia not typical. Confirm: elevated 17-OHP,
ACTH stim test. Refute: normal 17-OHP. Low probability: Exogenous
estrogen exposure. For: can cause gynecomastia. Against: no history of
exposure, triamcinolone is not estrogenic. Confirm: exposure history,
elevated estradiol. Refute: no exposure, normal labs. Low probability:
Malignant breast lesion. For: enlarging mass. Against: benign ultrasound
features, very rare in this age. Confirm: biopsy. Refute: benign
histology.

blocks.en:
Diagnostics: The immediate priority is to review the pending laboratory
panel (Table 1) and the results of the unspecified diagnostic procedure.
Required lab results include LH, FSH, estradiol, total testosterone,
DHEA-S, androstenedione, 17-hydroxyprogesterone, serum hCG, AFP, and
prolactin. If estradiol is elevated with suppressed LH/FSH, obtain
testicular ultrasound and adrenal CT/MRI to localize an
estrogen-secreting source. If hCG is elevated, perform testicular
ultrasound and chest/abdominal/CNS imaging to exclude ectopic
hCG-secreting tumors. If all hormones are prepubertal/normal, consider a
GnRH stimulation test to detect subclinical gonadarche or proceed to
tissue diagnosis if the mass persists or enlarges. A scrotal/testicular
ultrasound is mandatory to exclude an occult testicular neoplasm not
palpable on examination. Treatment: If benign physiologic gynecomastia
is confirmed by normal labs and imaging, reassurance and observation
with 3-6 month follow-up is the primary approach. Avoid empirical
anti-estrogen or aromatase inhibitor therapy until a hormonally active
tumor is excluded. If a specific cause is identified (e.g., tumor, CAH),
treat accordingly. If the mass persists, enlarges beyond 3-6 months, or
causes significant psychological distress despite a negative workup,
consider excisional biopsy or surgical referral for definitive
histology.

blocks.en:
An 8-year-old boy presents with an 18-month history of a right breast
mass that enlarged over 6 months, accompanied by fine pubic and axillary
hair (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Examination reveals a 2-cm firm,
mobile retroareolar mass, a small left breast bud, Tanner 2 pubic hair,
prepubertal testes (3 ml), and normal bone age. Ultrasound shows a
benign-appearing solid mass consistent with gynecomastia. The leading
syndromes are unilateral prepubertal gynecomastia and premature
adrenarche, while central precocious puberty is excluded by prepubertal
testes and normal bone age. The top hypothesis is idiopathic or early
physiologic gynecomastia, but peripheral estrogen excess
(testicular/adrenal tumor) and hCG-secreting tumors must be excluded.
Priority actions are to review the pending laboratory results (Table 1)
and the unspecified diagnostic procedure, and to perform a scrotal
ultrasound. If labs and imaging are normal, management is expectant with
reassurance. The greatest data gaps are the unavailable lab values and
diagnostic procedure results, which are essential to differentiate a
benign self-limited condition from an occult hormonally active tumor.

blocks.en: D.4.3 Pediatric Surgery
blocks.zh: D.4.3 小儿外科手术

blocks.en:
In March 2016 (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ), an 8-year-old boy presented
to the outpatient clinic with an 18-month history of a right breast mass
that had enlarged over the preceding 6 months. One week earlier, a
pediatrician at another facility had palpated a round, mobile subareolar
mass under the right areola, prompting referral. This chronology
establishes a subacute-to-chronic process with recent progression,
significant for pediatric surgery because a persistent and enlarging
discrete retroareolar mass in a prepubertal boy raises concern beyond
simple prepubertal gynecomastia and warrants surgical-pathologic
correlation. At the endocrinology clinic visit, parents denied nipple
discharge. History included seasonal allergies, eczema treated with
topical triamcinolone, and normal growth and development; no systemic
hormonal or off-label exposure is reported, which is relevant because
exogenous systemic steroids and certain medications can produce
gynecomastia, and absence of such exposure supports an endogenous or
idiopathic mechanism. Family history includes paternal grandmother with
breast cancer diagnosed at age 70, maternal grandfather with asthma, and
maternal grandmother with hypercholesterolemia; parents and sibling are
healthy. An elderly-onset female relative with breast cancer does not
significantly raise the index of suspicion for an inherited male breast
cancer syndrome in this 8-year-old, but it should be noted. On
examination, the patient appeared well, without dysmorphic features;
blood pressure 110/70 mm Hg, pulse 86 bpm, height 131 cm (68th
percentile), weight 28.4 kg (72nd percentile), BMI 16.5 (66th
percentile). Normal stature and BMI argue against an underlying
endocrinopathy such as hypothyroidism or hypercortisolism. A firm,
mobile 2 × \times 2 cm mass was palpable under the right areola, not adherent
to the skin; a small amount of soft breast tissue was palpable on the
left; fine, straight, lightly pigmented pubic hairs were noted on the
lower mons pubis, and very scant fine, light axillary hair was present
on close inspection. For pediatric surgery, the key findings are the
size (>2 cm, clearly outside the usual
'breast bud' range of pubertal
gynecomastia), unilateral predominance, firmness, mobility, and
non-adherence to skin or deep structures—features that mandate imaging
and likely excisional biopsy. Testicular volume was 3 ml with a
prepubertal phallus. Prepubertal testicular volume essentially excludes
a testosterone-secreting testicular tumor as the cause of the breast
mass, although it does not exclude an estrogen-secreting gonadal or
extragonadal source. A left-hand radiograph showed a bone age of 8
years, consistent with chronologic age, arguing against a significant
systemic hormonal drive and supporting an isolated, probably benign,
prepubertal process. Eight days after the endocrinology visit,
laboratory tests (Table 1) were obtained, and 13 days after the visit,
chest imaging was performed. The specific numeric laboratory values are
not reproduced in the supplied text and constitute a data gap for the
preconcilium analysis. Breast ultrasound (Dr. Pallavi Sagar, Figure 1)
demonstrated a well-circumscribed, oval, relatively hypoechoic, mobile
mass approximately 1.4 × \times 1.3 × \times 0.8 cm in the retroareolar region, with
smooth peripheral margins, superficial to the pectoralis muscle, long
axis parallel to the skin, minimal peripheral blood flow on color
Doppler, and no irregular margins, calcifications, or hypervascularity;
the contralateral left breast showed a normal breast bud.
Sonographically, the lesion is solid-appearing, well-defined,
superficial, and oriented parallel to the skin—features classically
described for a fibroadenoma-like or fibro-glandular proliferation, but
in a prepubertal boy the differential remains restricted and tissue
diagnosis is required. Important negative findings include absence of
skin retraction or fixation, nipple discharge, palpable lymphadenopathy,
dysmorphic features, and testicular masses, reducing the likelihood of
advanced or metastatic disease and hormonally active testicular tumors.
Data gap: the numeric results of the hormonal and tumor-marker panel in
Table 1 and the findings of the chest imaging study are not reproduced
in the supplied case excerpt; their values are necessary before final
surgical decision-making.

blocks.en:
The principal syndrome is a unilateral, persistent, enlarging breast
mass in a prepubertal male, confirmed by the 18-month history with
recent enlargement, the palpable 2 cm by 2 cm firm mobile right
retroareolar mass in March 2016, and the sonographic finding of a
well-circumscribed, hypoechoic, hypovascular nodule without malignant
features (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). The mass is realized through
localized proliferation or hormonal stimulation of mammary tissue in the
retroareolar region, superficial to the pectoralis muscle. The
pathogenetic mechanism that most plausibly underlies this syndrome is
localized, asymmetric proliferation of ductal and periductal
fibro-glandular tissue in the right breast, consistent with idiopathic
prepubertal or early-pubertal gynecomastia; in this child, the mass has
progressed beyond the typical small, transient 'breast
bud,' which is why surgical sampling is being
considered. A lower-probability mechanism is a true neoplasm of the
prepubertal male breast—most commonly a fibroepithelial lesion
analogous to a juvenile fibroadenoma, and very rarely a ductal carcinoma
or other malignancy—in which the same fibro-glandular proliferation is
clonal/expansile rather than hormonally driven. This is considered
because the lesion is unilateral, >2 cm, persistent for 18
months, and continues to enlarge, features that exceed the usual natural
history of simple pubertal gynecomastia. A concurrent syndrome of
premature adrenarche is suggested by fine pubic and axillary hair in an
8-year-old with prepubertal 3 mL testes, prepubertal phallus, and bone
age of 8 years; this is realized through early adrenal androgen
secretion independent of gonadal activation. This adrenarche is
significant because it does not explain the unilateral breast
mass—systemic estrogen excess would typically produce bilateral breast
enlargement and testicular or phallic changes, which are
absent—thereby supporting a localized rather than systemic endocrine
mechanism. The absence of central puberty is confirmed by prepubertal
genitalia and normal bone age, rejecting a
hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis-driven process as the cause of the
mass. A hormonally active endocrine tumor (for example, an hCG- or
estrogen-secreting gonadal or extragonadal germ-cell tumor) producing
secondary gynecomastia is explicitly considered and rejected on the
basis of prepubertal testicular volume (3 ml) and prepubertal phallus,
normal stature and BMI, bone age equal to chronologic age, and absence
of any reported features of precocious puberty beyond scant
pubic/axillary hair. If Table 1 hormonal and tumor-marker results show
elevated hCG, estradiol, or suppressed LH/FSH, this rejection must be
revisited. A chest-wall or pectoral soft-tissue neoplasm (for example,
rhabdomyosarcoma, desmoid tumor, or vascular malformation) presenting as
a 'breast' mass is rejected because the
lesion is retroareolar within the breast disc, mobile, non-adherent, and
superficial to the pectoralis muscle on ultrasound.

blocks.en:
High probability: persistent idiopathic (prepubertal/early-pubertal)
unilateral gynecomastia or benign fibroepithelial lesion (e.g.,
fibroadenoma). Arguments for: typical age, unilateral subareolar
location, mobility, lack of skin fixation, ultrasound features of a
well-circumscribed, parallel-to-skin, hypovascular, hypoechoic
retroareolar mass with no malignant features, prepubertal testicular
exam, and bone age equal to chronologic age (DOI: 10.1056/NEJMcpc1503831 ). Arguments against: the lesion has persisted for
18 months, is enlarging, measures >2 cm clinically, and is
firm and discrete—features more pronounced than the typical
self-limited pubertal breast bud. What would confirm: complete
resolution or regression after a defined observation interval, or
histology showing ductal hyperplasia with periductal stromal fibrosis
and no neoplastic features after excisional biopsy. What would refute:
histology demonstrating a neoplastic fibroepithelial or other tumor.
Medium probability: benign fibroepithelial neoplasm of the prepubertal
male breast—juvenile fibroadenoma-like lesion. Arguments for:
persistent, unilateral, well-circumscribed, solid, mobile,
sonographically 'benign' mass that
continues to grow in a prepubertal boy; fibroepithelial tumors are the
most common breast neoplasm in adolescents of both sexes. Arguments
against: this entity is exceedingly rare in 8-year-old boys and the
imaging is not specific. What would confirm: histopathology
demonstrating a pericanalicular or intracanalicular pattern with a
monoclonal-appearing stromal component. What would refute: histology
showing only usual ductal hyperplasia without a clonal stromal
proliferation. Low probability but must be excluded: malignant breast
neoplasm (for example, secretory carcinoma, ductal carcinoma, or other
rare pediatric breast malignancy). Arguments for: persistence and
progressive enlargement of a unilateral, firm, discrete mass. Arguments
against: classic sonographic benign features (smooth margins, parallel
orientation, no calcifications, no hypervascularity, no spiculation) and
the absence of any suspicious clinical findings such as skin retraction,
nipple discharge, fixation, or lymphadenopathy. Because this category,
even at low probability, can be life-threatening, it must be actively
excluded by histologic diagnosis before the mass is accepted as benign.
Low probability: estrogen- or hCG-secreting tumor (testicular, adrenal,
or germ cell). Arguments for include gynecomastia and adrenarche.
Arguments against include prepubertal testes (3 mL) without masses,
prepubertal phallus, normal bone age, and absence of other feminizing
signs. Confirmation would be elevated estradiol or hCG with
imaging-identified tumor; refutation would be normal hormone levels and
negative imaging. Low probability: drug-induced gynecomastia from
topical triamcinolone. Arguments for include documented exposure.
Arguments against include low systemic absorption with topical use and
absence of cushingoid features. Confirmation would be regression after
discontinuation; refutation is persistence after cessation. The
potentially dangerous conditions of malignancy and hormonally active
tumors must be excluded first through histopathology and hormone
studies.
